title: Associate Operations Manager für das Altersvorsorgedepot (f/m/d)
description: Bei Upvest verfolgen wir die Mission, Investieren so einfach zu machen wie Geldausgeben. Upvest befähigt Unternehmen, eine breite Palette an Anlageprodukten anzubieten und ihren Kund:innen ein erstklassiges Erlebnis im Bereich Kapitalmarktinvestments und Altersvorsorge zu ermöglichen. Die Upvest Investment API ist einfach zu integrieren, sodass Fintechs und Finanzinstitute Ressourcen sparen und sich voll auf ihr Kerngeschäft konzentrieren können. Wir sind stolz darauf, mit Europas führenden Fintechs und Finanzinstituten wie DKB, Revolut, N26 und Raisin zusammenzuarbeiten. Upvest wurde 2017 von Martin Kassing gegründet und vereint heute über 270 talentierte Fachkräfte aus mehr als 70 Nationen. Upvest wird durch ein Gesamtinvestment von 280 Mio. € von erstklassigen Investoren unterstützt, darunter BlackRock, Tencent, Sapphire Ventures sowie Bessemer Venture Partners, Earlybird, Notion Capital und Motive. Unsere jüngste Finanzierungsrunde über 110 Mio. € im März 2026 – angeführt von Sapphire und Tencent – dient als massiver Katalysator für unser Wachstum und ermöglicht es uns, ein erstklassiges Investment-Erlebnis zu bieten. Revolutioniere die Altersvorsorge in Deutschland Wir suchen einen Associate Operations Manager (f/m/d) rund um das Thema Altersvorsorgedepot, der die operativen Prozesse für diesen zentralen Geschäftsbereich durchführt. Deine Aufgaben: Verantwortung und Durchführung von Übertragungen, Zulagenmanagement, Bonusanträgen sowie der steuerlichen Abwicklung und dem Edge-Case-Handling unter strikter Einhaltung von SLAs und KPIs. Kontinuierliche Weiterentwicklung zum zentralen Fachexperten für alle Themen des operativen Tagesgeschäfts. Fachliche Unterstützung der Kundenteams bei der Betreuung ihrer Endnutzer sowie Beantwortung komplexer Fragestellungen rund um die Altersvorsorge. Laufende Optimierung der Arbeitsabläufe durch den gezielten Einsatz von KI, Automatisierungstools und interdisziplinäre Zusammenarbeit. Sicherstellung eines reibungslosen Betriebs sowie proaktive Adressierung von Risiken unter strikter Beachtung gesetzlicher Vorschriften und interner Richtlinien. Was Du mitbringst: Großes Interesse an der Arbeit mit künstlicher Intelligenz und der aktiven Nutzung von KI-Tools im Arbeitsalltag. Zuverlässigkeit und Belastbarkeit auch in Zeiten hohen Arbeitsaufkommens sowie ein gewissenhaftes Terminmanagement. Deutsch auf muttersprachlichem Niveau sowie verhandlungssichere Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift Ein hohes Maß an Eigeninitiative verbunden mit einer ausgeprägten Teamfähigkeit. Von Vorteil ist: Mehrjährige Berufserfahrung mit tiefem fachlichem Fokus auf die Riester-Rente sowie die damit verbundenen operativen Prozesse. Fundierte Erfahrung in der Datenanalyse und Prozessoptimierung unter Einsatz von Visualisierungstools sowie fundierte Kenntnisse in SQL, Python oder Workflow-Automatisierung (z. B. n8n). Praktische Erfahrung im produktiven Umgang mit Large Language Models (wie Claude) oder vergleichbaren KI-gestützten Lösungen. Wie wir in dich investieren: Arbeit mit Mehrwert: Wir bauen die Infrastruktur, die die Zukunft des Investierens in Europa prägen wird. Unsere Arbeit ist komplex, ambitioniert und sinnstiftend. Du arbeitest mit modernen Technologien und schaffst etwas völlig Neues - ohne Legacy-Systeme, ohne Grenzen. Wohlbefinden: Erhole dich mit 30 Tagen Jahresurlaub und profitiere von Sport- und Gesundheitsbenefits für einen aktiven Lebensstil. Zusätzlich hast du Zugang zu vertraulichem, professionellem Coaching und kannst bis zu 183 Tage pro Jahr remote aus dem Ausland arbeiten. Nach jeweils vier Jahren Betriebszugehörigkeit erhältst du außerdem UpRest, ein voll bezahltes Sabbatical von einem Monat. Weiterentwicklung: Wachstum liegt in unserer DNA. Jede:r Upvenger verfügt über ein persönliches Weiterbildungsbudget und die Freiheit, selbst zu entscheiden, wie es eingesetzt wird. Vergütung & Beteiligung am Unternehmenserfolg: Wir sind überzeugt, dass alle Upvenger zu unserem Erfolg beitragen. Deshalb bieten wir ein wettbewerbsfähiges, überdurchschnittliches Gehalt sowie eine Teilnahme an unserem Mitarbeiter:innen-Beteiligungsprogramm. Team-Events & Feiern: Nimm an unternehmensweiten Events wie UpFest, Team-Dinners, Offsites oder unserer Holiday Party teil, um dich zu vernetzen und gemeinsame Erfolge zu feiern. Inklusion: Wir fördern eine Kultur, in der sich alle zugehörig fühlen und entfalten können. Unsere Employee Resource Groups stärken Vielfalt, Inklusion und Vernetzung, zum Beispiel durch Upfem für unsere weiblichen Upvenger oder UpVergent, das Unterstützung für neurodivergente Upvengers und Allies anbietet. Unsere Werte: Make it easy for others. Wir vereinfachen Komplexes und handeln stets mit den besten Absichten. Own the outcome. Wir sind proaktiv, schnell und entscheidungsstark. Dabei zählt für uns Fortschritt mehr als Perfektion. Rise to the challenge. Wir denken groß und gehen über Grenzen hinaus. Neugier treibt uns an, wir lernen kontinuierlich und feiern Erfolge gemeinsam. Tell the story. Wir starten mit dem Warum - ein gemeinsame Mission gibt Richtung. Transparenz und Wissensaustausch helfen uns, andere zu befähigen und zu inspirieren. Upvest ist ein Arbeitgeber, der Chancengleichheit fördert. Wir schätzen Vielfalt und setzen uns für ein inklusives Arbeitsumfeld für alle Mitarbeitenden ein. Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Senior Fullstack Engineer (f/m/d)
description: At Upvest, we are on a mission to make investing as easy as spending money . Upvest empowers businesses to offer a wide range of investment products and the best experience in the field of capital market investment and retirement planning. Upvest’s Investment API is easy to integrate so that fintechs and financial institutions can save resources and fully focus on their core business. We are proud to partner with Europe’s leading Fintechs and financial institutions such as DKB, Revolut, N26 and Raisin. Founded in 2017 by Martin Kassing, Upvest now brings together over 270 talented professionals from more than 70 nationalities. Upvest is backed by €280M in total funding from world-class investors, including BlackRock, Tencent, Sapphire Ventures, and Bessemer Venture Partners, Earlybird, Notion Capital, and Motive . Our latest €105M funding round in March 2026 - led by Sapphire and Tencent - serves as a massive catalyst for our growth, allowing us to offer premier investment experience. About the role: Team's mission Upvest's core product is an API: the execution layer that moves securities for our clients. Upfront extends into the layer above it. It's Upvest's operational service panel for enterprise clients, giving their operations, support and compliance staff the ability to handle first-line requests themselves: looking into an end-user's account, checking what happened to an order, answering the question in front of them. Today their options are to ask Upvest support or to build a service panel of their own, which most of them won't do. Our mission is to prove that financial institution customers can replace their fragmented operations with Upfront. That case isn't settled yet, and this team is the one making it. Our users do this work all day, so a clumsy interface is how a task turns back into a ticket for us. Our clients are already asking what AI can do for their operations teams. Agentic operations, exposed over MCP, is where we think this goes. What it should look like in Upfront is still open, and we'd like the person in this role to help define it. Upfront is part of the Clients Tribe at Upvest. Together with the Public API and Tooling Apps teams we enable Upvest’s business to scale efficiently, accelerate our client’s time-to-market and embed intelligence and automation into client processes. Your mission You’ll focus on building what actually creates value for our clients. While our OKRs set the destination, we expect you to help map the route. We prioritize impact and shipping speed over a perfectly groomed backlog. Because you're on a client-facing team, the quality of your output directly impacts client trust – especially since we are handling their customers' money. In our domain, the bar is high: anything touching client funds must be correct and auditable, or it's an incident. We will give you the client context, access, and autonomy to figure out what needs building, rather than just handing you a rigid spec. We also expect you to challenge our internal processes if they are slowing down your efficiency or shipping speed. What you’ll do: Take operational problems from concept to production, working across our React/TypeScript frontend and Go backend services. Own modern interface security. Upfront is where external users act on real end-user data, so you will tackle per-client isolated environments, least-privilege access, and Auth0 integrations in a regulated space. Expand the operational surface across Upvest's internal domains and develop a deep understanding of how our core systems piece together. Help define how software delivery works in an AI-enabled company by pushing AI tooling to its limits to maximize quality and speed while staying compliant. Build agentic operations as we move toward exposing Upfront over MCP. Every action requires a strict audit trail, so you will solve real design problems around what an agent can do autonomously versus what requires human intervention. Work in weekly cycles with bi-weekly retrospectives to prioritize high-quality, high-frequency shipping. What you bring: A strong product engineering mindset where you care about the "why" just as much as the "how" and proactively bring ideas to the table. Solid backend experience in Go, Java, or Kotlin (we build in Go but will give you time to ramp up). Practical experience building modern client-facing interfaces using React and TypeScript. Experience building products that require per-customer configuration without devolving into a custom fork per client. Deep knowledge of authentication, authorization, and security best practices. A strong focus on quality, extensibility, and automated testing. True end-to-end ownership across containers, CI/CD pipelines, and relational data modeling. A working understanding of event-driven architectures. A pragmatic approach to engineering and the ability to make smart tradeoffs under constraints. Real-world experience using AI tools to drive software engineering workflows, not only writing code snippets . The ability to navigate undefined problems and align other teams without needing formal authority. It’s great if you have: Experience with Investment products or the Fintech domain, in general. Experience building operational or back-office tooling for business users. Experience with identity platforms such as Auth0, or with multi-tenant isolation. Experience with operating services in a decoupled, event-driven system, leveraging modern observability tooling (e.g. monitoring and tracing). How we Upvest in you: Best-in-class AI tools: Every Upvenger has €20,000 per year to spend on the best AI tools available — so you're always working with the most powerful models and tooling on the market. Impact-driven work: We’re building the infrastructure that will power the future of investing in Europe. It’s complex, ambitious, and meaningful. You’ll work with modern technologies and create something entirely new. No legacy systems, no limits. Wellbeing: Recharge with 30 days of annual leave and maintain a healthy lifestyle with sports benefits. Access confidential professional coaching and enjoy the flexibility to work remotely abroad for up to 183 days a year. Recharge with UpRest, a one-month fully paid sabbatical after every 4 years of working at Upvest. Development: Growth is in our DNA. Each Upvenger has access to a personal development budget and the freedom to decide how to use it. Flexible work environment: Work from any of our hubs in Berlin, London or Tallinn hybrid or remotely across Europe, depending on the role. We give you the choice and budget to work where you’re most comfortable and productive, either at home or in the office. You choose. Compensation and equity: We believe that all Upvengers contribute to our success and deserve a competitive, above-market salary and a participation in our employee equity program. Team celebrations: Participate in company-wide events, such as UpFest, dinners, offsites and our Holiday party, to connect with colleagues and celebrate our achievements. raw.title: Senior Fullstack Engineer (f/m/d)
raw.description:
At Upvest, we are on a mission to make investing as easy as spending money. Upvest empowers businesses to offer a wide range of investment products and the best experience in the field of capital market investment and retirement planning. Upvest’s Investment API is easy to integrate so that fintechs and financial institutions can save resources and fully focus on their core business.

We are proud to partner with Europe’s leading Fintechs and financial institutions such as DKB, Revolut, N26 and Raisin. Founded in 2017 by Martin Kassing, Upvest now brings together over 270 talented professionals from more than 70 nationalities. Upvest is backed by €280M in total funding from world-class investors, including BlackRock, Tencent, Sapphire Ventures, and Bessemer Venture Partners, Earlybird, Notion Capital, and Motive. Our latest €105M funding round in March 2026 - led by Sapphire and Tencent - serves as a massive catalyst for our growth, allowing us to offer premier investment experience.

About the role:

Team's mission

Upvest's core product is an API: the execution layer that moves securities for our clients. Upfront extends into the layer above it. It's Upvest's operational service panel for enterprise clients, giving their operations, support and compliance staff the ability to handle first-line requests themselves: looking into an end-user's account, checking what happened to an order, answering the question in front of them. Today their options are to ask Upvest support or to build a service panel of their own, which most of them won't do.

Our mission is to prove that financial institution customers can replace their fragmented operations with Upfront. That case isn't settled yet, and this team is the one making it. Our users do this work all day, so a clumsy interface is how a task turns back into a ticket for us. Our clients are already asking what AI can do for their operations teams. Agentic operations, exposed over MCP, is where we think this goes. What it should look like in Upfront is still open, and we'd like the person in this role to help define it.

Upfront is part of the Clients Tribe at Upvest. Together with the Public API and Tooling Apps teams we enable Upvest’s business to scale efficiently, accelerate our client’s time-to-market and embed intelligence and automation into client processes.

Your mission

You’ll focus on building what actually creates value for our clients. While our OKRs set the destination, we expect you to help map the route. We prioritize impact and shipping speed over a perfectly groomed backlog. Because you're on a client-facing team, the quality of your output directly impacts client trust – especially since we are handling their customers' money.

In our domain, the bar is high: anything touching client funds must be correct and auditable, or it's an incident. We will give you the client context, access, and autonomy to figure out what needs building, rather than just handing you a rigid spec. We also expect you to challenge our internal processes if they are slowing down your efficiency or shipping speed.

What you’ll do:

  • Take operational problems from concept to production, working across our React/TypeScript frontend and Go backend services.

  • Own modern interface security. Upfront is where external users act on real end-user data, so you will tackle per-client isolated environments, least-privilege access, and Auth0 integrations in a regulated space.

  • Expand the operational surface across Upvest's internal domains and develop a deep understanding of how our core systems piece together.

  • Help define how software delivery works in an AI-enabled company by pushing AI tooling to its limits to maximize quality and speed while staying compliant.

  • Build agentic operations as we move toward exposing Upfront over MCP. Every action requires a strict audit trail, so you will solve real design problems around what an agent can do autonomously versus what requires human intervention.

  • Work in weekly cycles with bi-weekly retrospectives to prioritize high-quality, high-frequency shipping.

     

What you bring:

  • A strong product engineering mindset where you care about the "why" just as much as the "how" and proactively bring ideas to the table.

  • Solid backend experience in Go, Java, or Kotlin (we build in Go but will give you time to ramp up).

  • Practical experience building modern client-facing interfaces using React and TypeScript.

  • Experience building products that require per-customer configuration without devolving into a custom fork per client.

  • Deep knowledge of authentication, authorization, and security best practices.

  • A strong focus on quality, extensibility, and automated testing.

  • True end-to-end ownership across containers, CI/CD pipelines, and relational data modeling.

  • A working understanding of event-driven architectures.

  • A pragmatic approach to engineering and the ability to make smart tradeoffs under constraints.

  • Real-world experience using AI tools to drive software engineering workflows, not only writing code snippets .

  • The ability to navigate undefined problems and align other teams without needing formal authority.

     

It’s great if you have:

  • Experience with Investment products or the Fintech domain, in general.

  • Experience building operational or back-office tooling for business users.

  • Experience with identity platforms such as Auth0, or with multi-tenant isolation.

  • Experience with operating services in a decoupled, event-driven system, leveraging modern observability tooling (e.g. monitoring and tracing).

     

How we Upvest in you:

  • Best-in-class AI tools: Every Upvenger has €20,000 per year to spend on the best AI tools available — so you're always working with the most powerful models and tooling on the market.

  • Impact-driven work: We’re building the infrastructure that will power the future of investing in Europe. It’s complex, ambitious, and meaningful. You’ll work with modern technologies and create something entirely new. No legacy systems, no limits.

  • Wellbeing: Recharge with 30 days of annual leave and maintain a healthy lifestyle with sports benefits. Access confidential professional coaching and enjoy the flexibility to work remotely abroad for up to 183 days a year. Recharge with UpRest, a one-month fully paid sabbatical after every 4 years of working at Upvest.

  • Development: Growth is in our DNA. Each Upvenger has access to a personal development budget and the freedom to decide how to use it.

  • Flexible work environment: Work from any of our hubs in Berlin, London or Tallinn hybrid or remotely across Europe, depending on the role. We give you the choice and budget to work where you’re most comfortable and productive, either at home or in the office. You choose.

  • Compensation and equity: We believe that all Upvengers contribute to our success and deserve a competitive, above-market salary and a participation in our employee equity program.

  • Team celebrations: Participate in company-wide events, such as UpFest, dinners, offsites and our Holiday party, to connect with colleagues and celebrate our achievements.

  • Inclusion: We’re committed to a culture where everyone belongs and thrives. Our Employee Resources Groups foster inclusion and connection, like Upfem for our female Upvengers, or UpVergent supporting neurodivergent Upvengers and allies.

Our Values:

  • Make it easy for others. We simplify the complex and act with the best intentions.

  • Own the outcome. We are proactive, fast and confident to get the job done, valuing progress over perfection.

  • Rise to the challenge. We aim high and push the boundaries. We stay curious, learn and celebrate our wins together.

  • Tell the story. We start with the Why to align on purpose. We are transparent and share knowledge to empower and inspire others.

Upvest is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

raw.title: Commercial Lead, DACH
raw.description:
We’re Heidi.

We're building the future of healthcare by giving every clinician the earth's finest AI Care Partner. Our platform has absorbed the administrative chaos of 175 million patient visits and supported 67 million clinical hours. Today, we support 2.8 million patient sessions a week across 190+ countries, in 110 languages and over 200 specialties.

Healthcare systems are failing us; clinicians spend more time on documentation than on patients, and the human connection that makes medicine worth practicing is eroding. Our mission is simple: double the world’s capacity for care and strengthen the human connection at its heart.

We found product-market fit with a freemium medical scribe that clinicians love. Now, we're expanding. Every task a clinician hands to Heidi is a patient who feels more attended to, a health system unclogged, and a clinician who gets to be a clinician again.

We’ve grown annual recurring revenue from $1 million to $50 million in two years.

To go further, we’ve secured US$340 million: a $100 million Series C led by Blackbird, with Phoenix Court, Point72 Private Investments and Headline, alongside a $240 million growth investment led by General Catalyst’s Customer Value Fund.

If you want to join us in doing work worth shipping, jump in.

The role

We’re looking for an experienced seller with an entrepreneurial mindset to help build Heidi’s next stage of growth across Germany, Austria and Switzerland.

There’s already momentum: clinicians using the product, customers recommending us and healthcare organisations coming to us with interest. You’ll build on that foundation by closing strategically important deals, creating new pipeline and turning individual adoption into broader organisational relationships.

This is a hands-on individual contributor role with a broad commercial remit. You’ll personally own opportunities from first conversation to signed agreement, while helping us develop partnerships, strengthen our market presence and figure out where to focus next.

You might spend one day building a business case with a hospital group, the next prospecting into a priority account, and another working with a potential partner or helping shape a local event. You’ll bring the judgement to choose what matters and the follow-through to make it happen.

 

What you’ll do

  • Own strategically important deals: Lead opportunities with practice groups, MVZs, clinics and hospital groups from discovery and demos through business case development, negotiation and close. Build relationships with clinical champions, operational leaders and executive decision-makers.

  • Build your own pipeline: Identify the accounts and segments worth pursuing, develop a clear approach and do the outreach yourself. Use targeted prospecting, introductions, local networks and creative approaches to open conversations.

  • Convert the demand coming to us: Respond quickly to inbound interest and use product adoption signals to uncover larger opportunities. Recognise when an enthusiastic clinician could become the starting point for a practice-wide or group-wide rollout.

  • Help buyers reach a decision: Understand their workflows, priorities and buying process. Bring the right stakeholders together, coordinate internal support on technical, security and procurement questions, and give pilots clear success criteria and a route to rollout.

  • Help build the wider market: Develop relationships with software providers, professional associations, clinical advocates and other potential partners. Work with colleagues on conferences, webinars, customer stories and commercial initiatives that create trust and qualified demand.

  • Improve how we sell: Turn what you learn into better messaging, account prioritisation and sales processes. Use AI and commercial tools to improve your effectiveness, keep the CRM accurate and maintain a realistic view of your pipeline and forecast.

  • Bring the market back into Heidi: Share clear evidence about why customers buy, what slows adoption and where product improvements or localisation could unlock growth. Work closely with Product, Marketing, Customer Success and the wider DACH team.

 

What you'll need

  • A proven record of selling and closing: You’ve personally owned a revenue target and can explain the deals you originated, how you won them and the results you delivered. Experience in B2B software or a similarly complex commercial environment is particularly relevant.

  • Strong sales craft: You know how to run discovery, build a compelling business case, develop champions and navigate opportunities involving several stakeholders. You can earn credibility with both a clinician and a CFO.

  • The ability to create opportunities: You’ve built pipeline through your own efforts and know how to turn an account list or a promising introduction into meaningful commercial progress.

  • A generalist’s range and judgement: You enjoy work beyond the immediate deal: testing a channel, developing a partnership, organising a customer session or solving a problem that is holding growth back. You can balance that breadth with delivering your number.

  • Independence and pace: You create structure when the playbook is still being written, make sensible decisions with incomplete information and follow through without being chased.

  • Fluent German and strong English: You can lead nuanced commercial conversations in German and work effectively with a global team.

  • Curiosity about healthcare and AI: You’ll learn the product properly, take clinicians’ concerns seriously and use AI thoughtfully in your own work. You’re open to feedback and willing to change your approach when the evidence changes.

Particularly useful experience

  • Being an early AE or helping grow a new territory at a scaling company.

  • Selling into DACH healthcare or another complex, regulated market.

  • Building partnerships or turning individual product usage into larger organisational deals.

How we show up

  • Build for the next decade, not next quarter. Our targets are outrageous on purpose. The world's health doesn't have the luxury of incrementalism.

  • Lead, don't wait. We treat tomorrow's problems today. Sometimes we build what's needed before it's wanted, and we're fine with that.

  • Follow the evidence. Trust the patient. We pursue truth relentlessly. But when the subjective and objective disagree, we treat the patient, not the numbers. Ego is a comorbidity we can't afford.

  • Own the outcome. Everyone here carries the company. Raise problems with solutions, solve them end-to-end, and never be a bystander.

  • Ship, measure, go again. A button today, a workflow tomorrow. More iterations beat better planning. We're precise at pace, not reckless.

  • Live in clinicians' reality. Not the ideal workflow, the twenty-patients-before-lunch actual one. We build for exhausted humans, and we'd better be decent ones while we do it.

 

Why Heidi?

You’ll join a team measured on real-world impact, not press cycles. We live and breathe the challenges of modern health systems, and are laser-focused on exacting the change we’d like to see. We’re medicos, engineers, builders and designers who’ve felt (on every side of the equation) what non-care feels like, the moral and practical toll as a provider or receiver.

Building what we’re building isn’t always easy. Standard tech playbooks routinely fail in healthcare, and the friction of the medical system will test your perseverance. But we didn’t choose easy, we chose a purpose-driven mission that actually matters. We hold ourselves to a higher standard because healthcare demands it. If you join Heidi, you recognize that the deeper question isn’t whether AI can solve the global healthcare crisis, but whose hands will shape it.

True A-players progress extremely fast here. The nature of the scale-up game is demanding, but we value sustainable performance and mental health. You're trusted to perform, and you set your schedule. We operate on outcomes > inputs, not process theatre. We all take the bins out, metaphorically and literally.

We take care of you.

We offer 25 days of paid time off per year, 24/7 mental health, coaching and wellbeing support through Sonder, a €100/month Healthy Heidi's wellness stipend, a €500 home office budget, a €700 annual learning and development budget, 26 weeks paid primary parental leave and 18 weeks paid secondary parental leave, fertility support up to €7,000, up to four weeks of work from anywhere per year, Recharge Days after major milestones and busy periods, 10 days per year of clinical leave for eligible clinical roles, and a hybrid working environment with 3 days in the office.

title: Social Content Manager
description: Bei Jellyfish glauben wir an die Kraft vielfältiger Perspektiven und an eine inklusive Zusammenarbeit. Wir begrüßen Menschen, die in diversen, kollaborativen Teams über sich hinauswachsen und die individuellen Sichtweisen anderer schätzen. Jellyfish ist eine globale Digital Marketing Agentur – eine einzigartige Verbindung aus Tech-Enthusiast:innen, kreativen Köpfen sowie Media- und Daten-Expert:innen, die ein gemeinsames Ziel vereint: unsere Kund:innen auf ihrer digitalen Reise weiterzubringen. Unser Anspruch, unterschiedliche Blickwinkel aktiv einzubinden, ist der Treibstoff für unsere innovativen Lösungen und Strategien. Wir hinterfragen den Status quo, denken Media-Aktivierung neu und entwickeln Stories mit Wirkkraft, für unsere internationalen Kund:innen und deren Zielgruppen. Gestalte mit uns eine Zukunft, in der berufliche und persönliche Weiterentwicklung Hand in Hand gehen. Stellenbeschreibung Du berichtest direkt an den Senior Social Content Manager und sorgst vom ersten Tag an für spürbaren Impact in unserer paneuropäischen Social-Creative-Abteilung. Wir sind stolz auf unsere langjährigen Partnerschaften mit globalen Entertainment-Größen und auf unsere Arbeit, die Kultur prägt und sich von der Masse abhebt. Von unserem Berliner Hub aus – mit echter hybrider Flexibilität – treibst du Social-First-Storytelling und kulturelle Relevanz für eine führende Streaming-Marke auf dem deutschen Markt voran. In enger Zusammenarbeit mit einem agilen Netzwerk aus Editor:innen, Designer:innen und Integrated Producer:innen in Berlin, London, Paris und Madrid steuerst du alles – von dynamischen Vertical Videos (TikTok und Instagram) über Creator-Kooperationen bis hin zur Live-Begleitung von Events vor Ort. Mit echtem kreativen Gestaltungsspielraum und einer offenen, kollegialen Unternehmenskultur bieten wir dir ein Umfeld, in dem mutige Ideen wachsen können. Deine Aufgaben Social Account Management Du arbeitest direkt mit einem großen Entertainment-Streaming-Kunden zusammen, pitchst eigene Kreativkonzepte und stimmst strategische Ziele gemeinsam ab. Du entwickelst herausragende Social-Aktivierungen für große Film- und Serienstarts sowie für saisonale und kulturelle Highlights. Du adaptierst globale Kampagnen-Assets und Toolkits für den deutschen Markt und passt Botschaften an, sodass diese lokale kulturelle Nuancen treffen. Du verantwortest die Social-First-Begleitung bei Live-Events, Marketing-Shoots und Presseveranstaltungen und briefst und leitest Talente vor Ort souverän an. Du übernimmst das gesamte kreative Copywriting über alle Formate hinweg – von Videoskripten und Interviewfragen bis hin zu In-Asset-Texten und plattformgerechten Captions. Du pflegst plattformübergreifende Redaktionspläne und koordinierst die tägliche Planung und Veröffentlichung freigegebener Inhalte auf allen organischen Kanälen. Social Media Expertise Du behältst Plattform-Updates, neue Nutzungsgewohnheiten und Popkultur-Trends in Echtzeit im Blick, um proaktiv reaktiven, kulturell relevanten Content zu pitchen. Du beobachtest Community-Stimmen sowie Performance-Daten nach dem Launch und übersetzt Analysen in fundierte Kampagnen-Debriefs, Abschlussberichte und konkrete Handlungsempfehlungen für Kund:innen. Projektmanagement Du arbeitest eng mit den Teams aus Design, Redaktion und Integrated Production zusammen, um sicherzustellen, dass alle Assets entlang Briefing, pünktlich und exakt im Einklang mit den Markenrichtlinien der Kund:innen geliefert werden. Du sorgst für reibungslose interne Produktionsabläufe, indem du verlässliche Zeitpläne erstellst und pflegst, Feedbackschleifen mit Kund:innen steuerst und Freigabeprozesse vom Briefing bis zum finalen Sign-off souverän begleitest. Dein Profil Deutsch auf C2- oder Muttersprachniveau mit einem sicheren Gespür für Copywriting, das auf Social-Media-Kanäle und den jeweiligen Tone of Voice der Marke zugeschnitten ist. Verhandlungssicheres Englisch im Arbeitsalltag. Mindestens 3 Jahre Erfahrung in der Konzeption, dem Scripting und der Produktion von Social Content auf nationalem Kampagnenniveau. Sicherer Umgang mit TikTok, Meta, YouTube und X sowie praktische Erfahrung mit Publishing- und Management-Tools wie der Meta Business Suite oder Sprinklr. Erfahrung im Community Management sowie ein intuitives Verständnis für Audience Engagement, Tone of Voice von Marken und plattformtypische Kommunikation. Tiefes Eintauchen in die deutsche Jugendkultur, Entertainment-Trends und Online-Fandoms – verbunden mit dem Talent, spontane Internet-Momente in mitreißenden Content zu verwandeln. Starke, teamorientierte Kommunikation über alle Touchpoints hinweg (vom täglichen Chat bis hin zu formellen Kundencalls und Präsentationen) sowie ein Händchen dafür, langfristiges Vertrauen und partnerschaftliche Beziehungen aufzubauen. Bei Herausforderungen holst du die richtigen Leute an einen Tisch, wägst verschiedene Optionen ab und findest pragmatische Lösungen. Hinweis: Wir legen mehr Wert auf Fähigkeiten, Fachwissen und persönliche Eigenschaften als auf langjährige Berufserfahrung oder klassische Studienabschlüsse. Wenn du Teil unseres kooperativen Teams werden möchtest, bewirb dich noch heute mit deinem Lebenslauf auf Englisch . Weitere Infos Werde Teil von Jellyfish und erlebe ein Arbeitsumfeld, in dem deine Weiterentwicklung Priorität hat, deine Erfolge gefeiert werden und du deinen Arbeitsalltag so gestalten kannst, wie es am besten zu dir passt. 💫 Flexibles Arbeitsumfeld: Arbeite bis zu 60 % deiner Zeit remote und gestalte deinen Arbeitstag dank flexibler Arbeitszeiten frei zwischen 8:00 und 18:30 Uhr. 📈 Weiterbildung nach deinen Vorstellungen: Sammle jeden Monat einen bezahlten Weiterbildungstag (2 Stunden pro Woche) für deine persönliche Entwicklung und nutze vollen Zugriff auf Jellyfish Learn. Leider häufen sich aktuell Fälle, in denen sich gefälschte Recruiter:innen als Jellyfish ausgeben und unseren Markennamen unrechtmäßig verwenden. Wenn du dir unsicher bist, ob eine E-Mail mit einem Jobangebot wirklich von Jellyfish stammt, oder wenn du einen Betrugsversuch vermutest, melde dies bitte an • €45K – €50K Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

You are someone who cares deeply about the quality of your work, the people who use it, and the success of your team.
You're a strong engineer with a wide view of the industry and an eye for detail, and you think in outcomes rather than tasks: why something is being built, how it will feel for users, and whether it made a difference once it shipped.
You're a natural collaborator who enjoys shaping product decisions, and you communicate openly, so people always know where things stand. You're fluent in AI-assisted development and use it with judgment, validating the outputs it produces.
 
We are looking for a Senior iOS engineer to join the team building the Airalo app. You'll make the technical decisions that keep the app healthy as it grows, and help drive technical excellence across the team.
 
 

What You'll Do:
  • Own features end to end: shape them with Product and Design, build and release them, and follow how they perform, so users get a best-in-class experience
  • Make sound architecture decisions and trade-offs, and write them up as proposals when the team needs to align
  • Own app performance and stability: investigate production issues, debug and profile, and fix root causes
  • Keep quality high through meaningful tests and thoughtful code reviews
  • Run product experiments and use the results to decide what to build next
  • Stay current with the iOS ecosystem and adopt new Apple platform capabilities early
  • Mentor engineers and contribute to our mobile guild, sharing knowledge across iOS and Android

    • What You'll Bring:
  • 5+ years of iOS development in Swift, with production experience in SwiftUI and UIKit
  • Deep platform fundamentals: architecture, concurrency, memory, performance, security and debugging
  • A track record of shipping and evolving apps at product companies, in cross-functional teams with product managers, designers, QA and backend engineers
  • Proven ability to work independently: you organise your own work, get yourself unblocked through research, your team or the guild, and deliver predictably, flagging early when plans change
  • Advanced AI-assisted development: you've built AI into how you design, code, test and review
  • Excellent written and spoken communication in English

    • Nice to have:

  • Experience building accessible, localized apps
  • Experience making apps fast and reliable on poor or unstable connections
  • Experience with in-app payments or e-commerce flows
  • A strong eye for UI craft and Apple's Human Interface Guidelines
  • Familiarity with agentic development workflows

If you embrace unconventional challenges, are unafraid to think differently and are driven to make an outsized impact, you’ll thrive here at Zopa, so join us, and make it count. Want to see us in action? Follow us on Instagram @zopalife

About the team
 

We are a mobile-first bank, and our iOS app is a critical part of how customers experience Zopa.

Having recently completed our migration to fully native mobile, we are now focused on making our iOS platform exceptional: fast, reliable, accessible and easy for engineers to build on.

You’ll join our Mobile Platform team, which owns the infrastructure, tooling and engineering standards that sit beneath our customer-facing mobile experiences. This includes areas such as app architecture, shared modules, our design system, observability, developer tooling and CI/CD.

The team is accountable for keeping these foundations reliable, scalable and easy for our product squads to build on. You’ll help shape the direction of mobile engineering at Zopa, improve the developer experience, and reduce the underlying technical complexity that product engineers need to manage.

The Mobile Platform team does not own individual customer journeys or build product features on behalf of squads. Product teams remain responsible for their customer experiences and the services they own, including responding to incidents within those product-owned areas. Instead, your focus will be on creating and maintaining the shared capabilities, tooling and standards that enable those teams to deliver safely and effectively.

You’ll also be part of a strong iOS engineering community, contributing to standards, sharing knowledge and helping us continue to mature our native engineering practice.


A Day in the life:
  • Partner closely with the Engineering Manager, Principal Mobile Engineer and Head of Mobile Engineering to deliver Zopa’s mobile strategy.
  • Help shape the technical direction and standards for iOS across Zopa.
  • Design and evolve shared modules, APIs, architecture and developer tooling that enable multiple teams to build and ship with confidence.
  • Identify technical risks early, using data, profiling and observability to improve performance, reliability and developer experience.
  • Stay highly hands-on, delivering production-quality Swift and SwiftUI code across platform and customer-facing product work.
  • Raise the capability of other engineers through pairing, code reviews, technical discussions and knowledge sharing.
  • Work closely with Product, Design, Backend and Android colleagues to make well-rounded decisions, influence direction and respect each discipline’s expertise.

    • About you:
  • Strong experience building and maintaining customer-facing iOS applications using Swift and SwiftUI.
  • Deep knowledge of iOS development, including concurrency, performance, memory management, testing, accessibility and security.
  • Sound architectural and API-design judgement, with a focus on simple, maintainable solutions and an excellent developer experience.
  • A proactive engineer who identifies problems, shapes practical solutions and influences improvements beyond their immediate team.
  • A collaborative teammate who raises the capability of others through coaching, pairing and knowledge sharing.
  • Comfortable constructively challenging ideas, while remaining open-minded and willing to change course when better evidence emerges.
  • Genuine curiosity about mobile engineering and the evolving iOS platform.

    • Added bonus:
  • Background in fintech, banking or another regulated, high-trust environment where reliability and customer confidence matter.
  • A track record of building shared libraries, platform capabilities or design systems that help engineering teams move faster.
  • Strong hands-on knowledge of UIKit and its place within modern iOS development.
  • Proven impact improving mobile CI/CD pipelines, release processes and developer tooling.
  • Confidence using AI-assisted development tools thoughtfully to improve productivity and code quality.
    • #LI-IB1

    At Zopa we value flexible ways of working.

    We value face-to-face collaboration and a good work-life balance. This hybrid role requires you to come to our London office 2-3 days a week.

    You'll also have the option of working from abroad for up to 120 days a year!* But no matter where you are, we’ll make sure you’ve got everything you need to thrive, both in your work and home life, from day one.

    *Subject to having the right to work in the country of choice

     

    Diversity Statement

    Zopa is proud to offer a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and backgrounds leads to better products for our customers and a unique company culture for our people. We are made up of nearly 50 nationalities, have a DE&I forum made up of Zopians wanting to make a difference and we are proud of our culture where everyone can bring their full self to work. Our approach to DE&I is reflected in our hiring process so please let us know if you require any reasonable adjustments. 

     

    Our approach to AI in interviews

    At Zopa, AI isn't something we're testing out — it's part of how we work every day. As a proud partner of Jobs 2030, we're committed to building AI fluency across our workforce, and we expect Zopians to use AI as part of how they do their jobs. 

    Because of that, we want to be transparent about how we think about AI use during our hiring process. 

    Behavioural and competency-based interviews: please don't use AI. These conversations are designed to understand you — your experiences, your judgment, and how you've approached real situations. An AI-generated answer can't tell us that. What it can do is get in the way of us finding out whether we're the right fit for each other. 

    Technical interviews: it depends on the role. Some technical stages actively welcome AI use, others don't. Your Talent Partner will let you know what's expected at each stage. Where AI is part of the assessment, we'll be interested not just in the outcome, but in how you used it – the tools you chose, your reasoning, and the decisions you made along the way.

raw.description:
This is not a back-office role. As a senior member of our globally distributed team, you’ll own the commercial and operational decisions that shape how Laminar wins work, delivers it and grows.

We're looking for a Commercial and Operations Senior Manager to strengthen the foundations of the business. That means tightening our commercial contracts, bringing structure to our operating procedures, and building processes that scale as we grow. If you enjoy untangling complex commercial and operational problems and turning them into clear, repeatable ways of working, we'd like to hear from you. This role requires someone with both commercial and operational experience.

If this sounds like you, Read on! 

(this will be a long write up but we like to give you all the details before you spend your time applying)

___________________________________________________________

We are Laminar Projects!

We are an award winning consultancy that implements technology to improve the delivery of complex construction projects. Improving construction strengthens the very foundation of human civilisation. (Watch our short film about it)

We also have a separate product team, Shape Construction, that takes the deep understanding of the projects we work on to develop construction management software products.

The core of all this is our true secret sauce; people. We only recruit kind and authentic people who are fast learners. We are deeply focused on designing a new type of place that is optimised for the flourishing of the people in the team first and foremost. This approach has allowed us to grow from just 2 people in 2017 to over 170 today and we are still very much at the beginning! Joining us isn’t just some “job,” we challenge you to be your best self in all aspects of life. 

Our vision is designed to align how we operate with the fundamental aspects that enable anyone to have a fulfilled life:  

  • Connects us with meaningful relationships
  • Inspires us to develop ourselves to become better humans
  • Empowers us to pursue our own learning adventures

4 core values for a good life

We believe a life of human flourishing is all about meaningful relationships with others and challenging yourself to create a positive impact. Our four core values are grow yourself, care about people, execute to greatness and build civilisation. This philosophy goes much deeper and you can see more on our website.

We are achieving this vision through the following two missions:   

  1. To fully digitise the construction of human civilisation
  2. To create a new type of organisation that enables human flourishing while delivering a huge positive impact on society

___________________________________________________________

The Role 

Purpose of the role 

As Commercial and Operations Senior Manager, you'll play a pivotal role in protecting and growing Laminar's commercial position, as well as strengthening and continually improving our operational procedures. You'll own the frameworks that govern how we contract with clients and suppliers, manage commercial risk, and run the operations and commercial functions day to day. You'll be the person who makes sure our growth rests on sound contracts, clear policies and efficient operations. That gives our consultants the freedom to focus on delivering great work for clients.

 

Team 

This is partly a new function, and you'll be building the commercial side of it from the ground up. You'll set its direction, shape its ways of working and grow the team over time. You'll work closely with leadership, group operations, delivery, bids, finance and people teams to make sure the Laminar operations and commercial function gives high-quality support across Laminar.

 

Your top three objectives 

  1. Get our contracts up to standard. Review and standardise Laminar's client and supplier contract templates, terms and approval processes, so that commercial risk is understood, controlled and consistently managed.
  2. Build a robust operating model. Document, streamline and embed the core operational procedures (such as contract lifecycle, onboarding of clients and associates, and commercial reporting) so the business runs predictably as we scale.
  3. Establish the operations and commercial function as a trusted partner. Set up the governance, tools and reporting that give leadership clear visibility of performance, risk and opportunity. This should support better decisions on pricing, bids and growth. 
 

Your top five responsibilities 

  • Build a strong Laminar operations and commercial function: Design and lead Laminar's operational and commercial functions, covering its structure, processes, tools and ways of working, so it can support a growing, globally distributed business.
  • Commercial and operational management: Own the end-to-end contract lifecycle: drafting, negotiation, review, approval, change control and renewal. Oversee commercial risk, pricing inputs, supplier and associate agreements, and operational performance.
  • Develop and enforce policies: Create, maintain and embed clear commercial and operational policies and procedures, such as delegated authority, contract approvals, risk management and compliance. Make sure they are understood and followed across the business.
  • Collaborate across teams: Work with leadership, delivery, bids, finance and people teams to give practical commercial advice. That includes supporting bids and proposals, resolving contractual issues, and making sure commercial decisions support client outcomes.
  • Functional leadership and promoting culture: Lead by example as a senior member of the team. Build a culture of commercial awareness, accountability and continuous improvement, and coach others so good commercial practice becomes part of how Laminar works. 

 

Your Capabilities

You'll be a proven commercial and operations leader who can switch easily between strategist, project manager, negotiator, communicator and doer to make things better. As a candidate, you should have:

Must-Have (The fundamentals) 

  • Mastery: Significant experience in operations management and commercial and contract management, ideally in a consultancy or professional services setting. You're confident drafting, reviewing and negotiating commercial contracts and managing contractual risk.
  • Communication: A precise, structured communicator in English, both written and verbal. You can explain complex issues clearly to non-specialists and senior stakeholders.
  • Leadership: You can manage multiple projects and priorities at once, make sound judgement calls, and work well with cross-functional teams and stakeholders.
  • Impact: A track record of improving how organisations work, going well beyond the basics.
Nice to Have (If you don’t have it now, you will after joining) 
  • Mastery: Experience with commercial contract reviews and commercial management. A relevant qualification (e.g legal or commercial degree]) is a plus.
  • Global perspective: Experience supporting a distributed or multi-jurisdiction business, including contracting across different regions.
  • Leadership: A proven leader, coach or developer of teams, ideally with experience building a new function from scratch.
  • Impact: A track record of putting in place scalable, repeatable commercial and operational solutions, such as contract management systems, approval workflows or reporting frameworks, that made a significant positive difference to a business. 

 

Laminar isn’t the place for you if any of the following is true: 

  • You want an easy, chilled-out role without much challenge
  • You like to be the smartest person in the room
  • You don’t like continuously receiving honest candid feedback
  • You prefer to do your own thing rather than work with a team

___________________________________________________________

Benefits

The Standard Stuff

  • Health Insurance Scheme. Comprehensive private health coverage - for you and your family. Because your well-being is our priority
  • Pension Scheme. A competitive plan to help you plan for the long term - plus salary sacrifice options available to maximize your savings
  • Bonus Scheme. As a permanent member of the team, you’ll share in our success. Our annual bonus is designed to reward both the now and the future - with a flexible mix of cash and high-growth equity that you choose. Bonuses are discretionary and based on performance
  • Professional body membership. One fee covered per year - so you can stay connected to your field and develop your craft
  • Cycle to Work Scheme. A tax-efficient way to get wheels - and do your bit for the environment

 

The Life-Changing Stuff 

  • Flexibility: Getting things done is what really matters, not what time of day you do it. That means you don’t have to ask permission for things like picking up your kids or going to the doctor, just keep your team in the loop if you think they will be affected.
  • Grow your whole self: Our leaders are more like coaches and one of our main objectives is to give 5 years’ worth of learning and development for every 1 year with us. You have a coach, mentor, well-being therapist and a development-orientated environment: That’s literally what our vision is all about and the primary reason Laminar exists.
  • Be surrounded by the best: We only hire and retain the very best people. You might be used to being the smartest in the room but that won’t be the case in Laminar. You will be surrounded by people you can learn from. We are 100% meritocratic so fast progression is the norm. You will be supported to excel in whichever areas you are most interested in! With Laminar, development is unbounded
  • Long-term impact: We are focused on solving the biggest issues in construction project delivery in a way that can spread and outlast us

___________________________________________________________

Important! Applying properly

We get thousands of applications so please write us a letter as part of your application explaining:

  • Why do you want to join us?
  • If you joined, where do you think you could make the most impact and how?

We aren't a giant faceless corporation; we really care about the people who want to join our team so all applications will be read thoroughly by our key leaders. In terms of application, we usually start with an intro call to tell you what we are all about in a casual conversation. That helps you to know us a bit better and tell us a bit about yourself.

description: <div class="content-intro"><h2><strong>About Sayari:&nbsp;</strong></h2> <div> <p>Sayari is the judgment infrastructure for trustworthy AI in economic security and commercial risk. You bring the network and the credibility that only years inside this sector can build.</p> <p>You won’t be the first rep at Sayari, but you will be one of the first people anywhere selling agentic investigation and risk agents into this vertical, on a foundation of data other vendors in our space don’t have. That’s the pitch you’ll be making, and it’s a true one.</p> <p>This is a senior, relationship-led seat focused on enterprise outcomes: multiyear agreements of $2M+, and agentic AI adoption that spreads into every adjacent buying center inside your accounts. Use early wins as references to open net-new budget across the account.</li> <li><strong>Inform the roadmap.</strong> You are on the front line of how this vertical reacts to agentic AI. Take that market intelligence back to Product and Engineering.</li> <li><strong>Run a rigorous pipeline.</strong> Maintain a predictable pipeline using a structured sales methodology, and give leadership a forecast they can plan against.</li> </ul> <h2>Who You Are</h2> <ul> <li><strong>A domain expert.</strong> 15+ years immersed specifically within the financial services blue-chip segment with C-Suite level context with a focus on banking compliance, risk and technology with a real, live and verifiable network already established inside that sector. Not adjacent experience. You know the regulatory environment, the day-to-day challenges practitioners face, and the trends shaping the sector.</li> <li><strong>A proven closer.</strong> A history of closing multimillion-dollar, multiyear agreements and driving net-new revenue from both existing complex accounts and new logos, which you can walk through in specific, named detail.</li> <li><strong>A strong communicator.</strong> Executive presence that lets you explain data provenance and AI reasoning to non-technical senior stakeholders, and be treated as a peer rather than a vendor.</li> <li><strong>A strategist.</strong> You navigate complex procurement, legal review, and multithreaded account politics, and can move from a single buyer into two or more adjacent buying centers. This is a network-and-credibility hire, not a “we have no leads” hire.</li> </ul> <p><strong>WHY TOP PERFORMERS CHOOSE SAYARI</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Uncapped Revenue Upside: </strong>An aggressive, uncapped commission structure with market leading accelerators for expansion revenue, and no bonus caps.</li> <li><strong>Genuinely Novel Product: </strong>Sell agentic AI that shows its work and traces every finding to a primary source. Not a black box, and not a chatbot wrapper. You will be one of the first people selling autonomous investigation and risk agents into this vertical anywhere in the market.</li> <li><strong>Elite Benefits: </strong>&nbsp;UK: fully paid private medical, dental, vision, salary sacrifice benefits.</li> <li><strong>Retirement: </strong>UK: 8% pension</li> <li><strong>True Rest: </strong>UK: 25 days plus bank holidays, plus a company-wide winter shutdown and other market leading leave policies.</li> </ul> <div>&nbsp;</div> <div><em>Sayari is an equal opportunities employer. Today, high delivery costs act as a hidden tax on e-commerce, quietly shaping what can be sold online and limiting who can participate. We envision a world where more goods move more freely between more people , making the online shopping experience seamless and accessible to everyone. Most of that never shows up on a map. Relay sees the last mile through couriers' own devices: GPS traces from live deliveries that show where they park, which entrance they use and how long each handover takes. Partner with Operational Research, Courier Intelligence and Engineering so correct addresses and doors flow into routing and decisions. Collaborate generously, and explain complex ideas simply. Don't tick every box? If this problem excites you, we'd still love to hear from you. Who Thrives at Relay? Aim with Precision: You define problems clearly and measure your impact meticulously. Play to Win: You chase bold bets, tackle the hard stuff, and view constraints as fuel, not friction. 1% Better Every Day : You believe that small, consistent improvements lead to exponential growth. You move quickly, deliver results, and learn from every experience. All In, All the Time : You show up and step up. You take ownership from start to finish and do what it takes to deliver when it counts. People-Powered Greatness : You invest in your teammates. You give and receive feedback with care and candour. You build trust through high standards and shared success. Grow the Whole Pie : You seek out win-win solutions for merchants, couriers, and our customers, because when they thrive, so do we. If these resonate, and you combine strong technical fundamentals with entrepreneurial drive, let’s connect. raw.description:
About Lendable

Lendable is on a mission to build the world's best technology to help people get credit and save money. We're building one of the world’s leading fintech companies and are off to a strong start:

  • One of the UK’s most exciting unicorns with a team of over 800 people

  • Among the fastest-growing tech companies in the UK

  • Profitable since 2017

  • Backed by top investors including Balderton Capital and Goldman Sachs

  • Loved by customers with the best reviews in the market (4.9 across 10,000s of reviews on Trustpilot)

So far, we’ve rebuilt the Big Three consumer finance products from scratch: loans, credit cards and car finance. We get money into our customers’ hands in minutes instead of days.

We’re growing fast, and there’s a lot more to do: we’re going after the two biggest Western markets (UK and US) where trillions worth of financial products are held by big banks with dated systems and painful processes.

Join us if you want to

  1. Take ownership: you are trusted to make decisions that drive a material impact on the direction and success of Lendable from day 1

  2. Work in small teams of exceptional people: Lendies are relentlessly resourceful. We challenge the status quo to solve problems and find smarter solutions

  3. Build the best technology in-house: we use new data sources, machine learning and AI to make machines do the heavy lifting

About the role

This role is for someone wanting to start a career in operations within a financial services firm. You'll join as a Graduate focused on working complaints and train to become a fully competent Complaints Officer, investigating and resolving our more complex customer interactions across loans, cards and auto-finance. A critical role to help the business understand how it can serve customers better.

This is a casework role. From early on you will hold your own caseload, speak to customers directly, make decisions on whether we got it right, and put things right where we didn't. You will be supported through structured training, coaching and quality feedback as you develop in the role

Some of the areas you'll delve into are:

  • The regulatory framework for complaints: FCA regulation, the DISP rules, Consumer Duty, and how the guidance is applied to real cases.

  • Investigation technique: gathering evidence, interrogating system records and call recordings, and testing what actually happened against what should have happened.

  • Decision making and redress: reaching fair and objective outcomes, and calculating and explaining any compensation due.

  • Customer communication: writing final response letters that break complex issues down into plain English.

  • The Financial Ombudsman Service: how cases are referred, how FOS reaches its view, and how we apply those learnings to future cases.

  • Root cause and feedback: spotting the product and process failures behind complaints and feeding them back to frontline and product teams.

Reporting to a Complaints Manager within the Operations Team, you will be responsible for a live caseload and for the quality of the decisions you make on it.

No prior complaints experience needed, we care about how you think, not what you already know. This role requires an ability to learn quickly, work to deadlines and support our customers effectively.

Your team's objectives

Lendable aims to resolve all complaints promptly, ensuring that they are investigated diligently and fairly for customers. We are committed to providing excellent customer service and to reaching the right outcomes for our customers.

Feedback is an important part of how we evolve as a business. The team is encouraged to speak up, take each complaint on its own merits and provide valuable insight back into the business so we can improve and grow.

Our ability to handle complaints effectively for our customers and therefore for us as a business has never been more important than now, as we expand our existing products in the UK and US financial markets.

What you'll be doing

  • Investigating and resolving complaints about our loans, cards and auto-finance products, taking each case on its own merits

  • Self-managing a varied and increasingly complex caseload: prioritising cases, choosing the best contact mechanism for each customer, and working efficiently enough to meet our KPI minimum standards

  • Communicating with complainants in writing and by phone — managing expectations, handling difficult situations with tact and professionalism, and finding solutions to the issues raised

  • Writing professional final response letters that set out our decision, our rationale and the customer's right to refer to the Financial Ombudsman Service

  • Following our complaint handling standards and keeping clear records, making sure every decision is backed by demonstrable evidence and a documented rationale

  • Working to resolve complaints without the customer needing to refer to FOS, and applying the learnings from both internal and FOS outcomes to future cases

  • Feeding back to frontline and product teams on the product and process improvements your cases surface, across Operations and the wider Lendable business

  • Keeping your knowledge of Lendable's products current through effective use and review of our policies, procedures and business tools

  • Turning your hand to other areas of operational need as the business requires

What we're looking for

  • Educated to degree level

  • Exceptional written communication - you can structure an argument and explain a complex decision clearly to someone who is not an expert

  • An aptitude for investigation, analysis, problem-solving and dispute resolution

  • Strong organisation and self-management - you can hold a caseload, prioritise it and work to deadlines without being chased

  • Sound judgment and a sound moral compass: willing to speak up to make sure good customer outcomes stay at the heart of what we do

  • Resilience and adaptability in a fast-paced, changing environment

  • A willingness to learn FCA regulation and the DISP complaint handling rules and guidance

The interview process

We're not a corporation so we try our best to get things moving as quickly as possible. For this role we'd expect:

  • A 15 minute cognitive assessment

  • A quick phone call with one of the Talent team

  • An onsite assessment centre with a role focus and a final stage interview with the Complaints Management team to discuss your fit and capability for the role.

Life at Lendable

  • Winning team: the opportunity to scale up one of the world’s most successful fintech companies

  • Flexible working: flexible approach tailored to each role. Hybrid roles require three days in-office weekly; fully remote roles include regular opportunities for in-person connection through socials and off-sites

  • Socials & connection: opportunities and events to come together, socialise, and get to know each other beyond the office walls

  • Health coverage: support for your physical and mental wellbeing, including private health cover

  • Retirement & savings: long-term financial wellbeing through retirement savings plans

  • Employee referral programme: earn a competitive bonus when you refer successful new team members

  • Office meals & snacks: enjoy a fully stocked kitchen, plus complimentary lunches prepared by in-house chefs on in-office days at select locations

  • Sustainable commuting: cycle-to-work and electric vehicle salary sacrifice schemes available in select locations

Please note: The availability and details of specific benefits vary by location and role. For more information, please speak to your Talent Partner.

Check out our blog!

description: <div class="content-intro"><h3><strong>Who we are:</strong></h3> <p>Burson, part of WPP, is the global communications leader built to create value for clients through reputation. For more information, visit <a href="WPP.com">WPP.com</a>&nbsp;</p> <p>For more information visit&nbsp;<a href="https://www.bursonglobal.com/">bursonglobal.com</a> and follow us on <a href="https://www.linkedin.com/company/burson/posts/?feedView=all">LinkedIn</a> and&nbsp;<a href="https://www.instagram.com/burson.global/?hl=en">Instagram</a>.</p></div><p><strong>More about the role:</strong></p> <p></p> <p>As Director, Intelligence &amp; Insight, UK, you will help lead the growth of Burson’s Intelligence &amp; Insights business across a portfolio of priority clients. Reporting to the Head of Intelligence &amp; Insights, UK, you will act as senior counsel to clients and help the team continue to evolve in delivering outstanding value; identifying where intelligence can answer real business and reputation questions, shaping those opportunities into clear briefs, and turning data-led outputs into recommendations that senior stakeholders act on.</p> <p>You will also play a leading role in how our intelligence offer evolves. Working with the regional Intelligence &amp; Insight hub, product and technology teams, you will identify where our methodologies need to develop to meet changing client needs, and make sure every new approach is clearly tied to the value it delivers. The role requires a strong understanding of the UK communications market, emerging technologies and the commercial potential of data, AI and intelligence in client work.</p> <p><strong>What you'll do:</strong></p> <p></p> <ul> <li><strong>Growth:</strong>&nbsp;Own the growth agenda for intelligence across priority UK clients. Work with client leads to build, shape and convert pipeline, using Burson’s AI suite, wider tech stack and WPP Open platform to address live client challenges. Hold accountability for the revenue and commercial performance of your portfolio.</li> <li><strong>Senior Counsel:</strong>&nbsp;Act as a trusted adviser to senior client stakeholders across communications, marketing and corporate affairs. Frame business and reputation challenges, guide decisions with evidence, and lead senior presentations and workshops that demonstrate the value of intelligence.</li> <li><strong>Opportunity Identification:</strong>&nbsp;Spot where intelligence can add value across existing accounts and new business. Lead intelligence input to pitches and work with market leadership to position intelligence as a differentiator in winning and growing client relationships.</li> <li><strong>Methodology Development:</strong>&nbsp;Identify opportunities to enhance and evolve our intelligence methodologies so they keep pace with client needs. Work with the regional hub and product teams to test, refine and scale new approaches, ensuring each one delivers measurable client value.</li> <li><strong>Team Leadership:</strong>&nbsp;Lead, mentor and develop members of the Intelligence &amp; Insight team, and equip account teams to use data and intelligence confidently and commercially. Set clear briefs for the regional hub and hold quality sign-off on outputs.</li> <li><strong>Thought Leadership:</strong>&nbsp;Shape Burson’s point of view on data, AI and their application in communications. Contribute to industry publications, speak at conferences and represent Burson as a leading voice in the data and intelligence space.</li> <li><strong>Collaboration:</strong>&nbsp;Work closely with the I&amp;I leadership team, account leadership and regional Intelligence &amp; Insight teams to ensure clients benefit from the best of Burson’s data, AI and advisory capabilities.</li> <li><strong>Data Ethics:</strong>&nbsp;Ensure all data projects adhere to Burson's data ethics standards and comply with relevant regulations. Promote responsible data practices within the agency and among clients.</li> </ul> <p></p> <p><strong>Experience that contributes to success:</strong></p> <p></p> <ul> <li>Proven experience in data, intelligence, research or measurement, including senior client-facing roles in a communications agency or consultancy.</li> <li>A proven track record of driving commercial growth, including building pipeline, winning new business and expanding client relationships.</li> <li>Experience counselling senior client stakeholders, with the credibility to challenge thinking and guide decisions.</li> <li>Strong methodological grounding across social, press, search and web analytics, research and measurement, with a record of developing approaches that meet evolving client needs.</li> <li>Deep understanding of the communications market, emerging technologies and the application of data and AI in communications.</li> <li>Ability to translate complex data into clear, actionable recommendations.</li> <li>Experience leading, developing and inspiring teams.</li> <li>Passion for innovation and a commitment to data ethics.</li> </ul> <p><span data-teams="true">Burson UK was named Cannes Lions Agency of the year 2026!</span></p> <p></p> <p><strong>#LI-CY1</strong></p><div class="content-conclusion"><h3><strong>You belong at Burson:</strong></h3> <p>Our vision is for Burson to be the leading ‘academy company’ for creative communications professionals and emerging leaders. We provide a dynamic environment where ambitious colleagues come to elevate their skills, expand their networks, and ultimately, produce the best solutions for today’s leading brands. Our commitment to your growth is reflected in our robust benefits and people programs, which include professional development opportunities, mentorship programs with industry leaders, a vibrant and inclusive company culture fostering collaboration and innovation and packages designed to reward and retain top talent. We invest in our people because we believe their success is our success.</p> <p>At Burson, we’re an agency of learn-it-alls. We recognize that the things we do best, creativity and communications, require a level of nuanced understanding. That’s why it’s imperative for us to hire extraordinarily talented people of all backgrounds and identities. Without that we can’t do the essential work of inspiring bold ideas, fostering constructive dialogue, cultivating meaningful experiences, and driving innovation and creativity for our partners. Your unique point of view—your talent—is what makes you a #BursonPerson, and it’s how we deliver exceptional results for our clients, together.</p> <p>We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection. That's why we’ve adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office around four days a week. If you require accommodations or flexibility, please discuss this with the hiring team during the interview process.</p> <p>When you click the "Submit Application" button below, this will send any information you add below to Burson.
