title: Senior Data Analyst
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>We're the world's leading consumer healthcare platform, supporting millions of patients across the US, Australia, the UK, Germany, Japan, Spain and Canada.</p> <p>We're driven by the belief that good health should last a lifetime, and that to get there we need to deliver the personalised, high quality and empathetic care that the traditional system cannot support.</p> <p>You'll partner with our care teams of prescribers, nurses, health coaches, pharmacists and dietitians to support patients across preventative health, weight management and specific women's and men's health conditions.</p> <p>We joined Hims &amp; Hers so that you can do all of the above on a bigger scale, with more ambition, a stronger global brand and the resources to deliver care to patients in dozens of countries.</p> <p>We're looking for people who appreciate and are excited by the enormity and uniqueness of this challenge, and want to work in the most ambitious, smart, fast moving and positive sum environment of their lives to transform how healthcare is delivered globally.</p> <p>We hope that's you.</p></div><p class="p1"><strong>About the role</strong></p> <p class="p2">We're looking for a Senior Data Analyst who will help our UK business understand performance, make better decisions and improve how quickly we learn. You'll work directly with leaders across Growth, Product, Operations and Finance, owning important commercial questions from problem framing through diagnosis, recommendation and measurement.</p> <p class="p3">This isn't primarily a reporting role. We want someone who notices when something changes, works out why, and helps the business act. You'll also turn recurring questions into reliable, reusable analytical capabilities, contributing to our move towards proactive monitoring, automated diagnosis and trusted self-service insights. You'll collaborate with analytics colleagues across Eucalyptus and Hims &amp; Hers while remaining close to UK business priorities.</p> <p class="p3"><strong>What you’ll do</strong></p> <ul> <li class="p1"><strong>Diagnose performance. </strong>Investigate movements in acquisition, conversion, retention and revenue. Validate the signal, quantify the drivers, distinguish correlation from causation, and identify the controllable levers behind the change.</li> <li class="p1"><strong>Drive decisions. </strong>Work backwards from commercial objectives, challenge assumptions and turn ambiguous questions into focused analysis. Recommend concrete actions, explain trade-offs and follow up to establish whether the decision worked.</li> <li class="p1"><strong>Measure impact. </strong>Design and evaluate experiments, launches and operational changes. Use statistical reasoning, cohort analysis and appropriate causal methods to make credible claims, including when evidence is incomplete.</li> <li class="p1"><strong>Build repeatable capabilities. </strong>Turn frequent investigations into trusted metrics, models, monitoring, diagnostic workflows and self-service tools. Help strengthen shared definitions and reusable approaches across markets rather than rebuilding the same analysis repeatedly.</li> <li class="p1"><strong>Work AI-natively. </strong>Use AI to accelerate exploration, coding, validation and repetitive investigation, and help develop increasingly automated analytical workflows. Maintain ownership of assumptions, evidence and correctness: faster answers only matter when they can be trusted.</li> <li class="p1"><strong>Ship and learn quickly. </strong>Deliver useful intermediate answers early, make uncertainty visible, seek stakeholder feedback and iterate. Balance speed with rigour rather than waiting for a polished, one-off analysis.</li> <li class="p2"><strong>Raise the analytical bar. </strong>Review work constructively, share methods openly, question weak conclusions and contribute to a team culture of curiosity, clarity and high standards.</li> </ul> <p><strong>About you</strong></p> <ul> <li class="p1"><strong>Strong foundations. </strong>Around 5+ years in analytics, ideally in a consumer, subscription, e-commerce or digital business. Advanced SQL and practical Python skills; comfortable with complex datasets, modelling and analytical validation.</li> <li class="p1"><strong>Commercial and analytical judgment. </strong>You can structure messy problems, identify what matters to the business and separate meaningful drivers from noise. You know when further precision is worth the time.</li> <li class="p1"><strong>Sound measurement. </strong>Experience with funnels, cohorts, experimentation and statistical inference. You understand the limits of observational data and communicate confidence and uncertainty accurately.</li> <li class="p1"><strong>Ownership and influence. </strong>You independently lead important analyses, build productive relationships with senior stakeholders and communicate recommendations clearly, including when you need to challenge the prevailing view.</li> <li class="p1"><strong>Systems mindset. </strong>You look for patterns in repeated requests and create durable solutions. Experience with semantic metrics, BI or data modelling is valuable; you do not need to be a platform engineer.</li> <li class="p1"><strong>Curiosity about AI. </strong>You already use or actively explore AI-assisted workflows and can explain both where they create leverage and where human judgment and verification remain essential.</li> </ul> <p><strong>What success looks like in your first six months</strong></p> <ul> <li>Become a trusted analytical partner to UK stakeholders and independently own material commercial questions</li> <li>Deliver evidence-backed diagnoses that lead to clear actions, with impact or follow-up measurement</li> <li>Improve the reliability or usability of a core UK metric, model or analytical workflow</li> <li>Replace at least one recurring manual investigation with a reusable, appropriately validated capability</li> <li>Demonstrate faster learning cycles through early delivery, iteration and thoughtful use of AI tools</li> </ul> <p><strong>Why join us?</strong><br><br>You'll work on consequential problems spanning patient journeys, growth, retention and healthcare operations, with the autonomy to influence decisions and the support of a global analytics organisation. We're actively evolving the craft of analytics: improving foundations, shortening the path from signal to action and building tools that let people answer better questions at scale. You'll help shape that evolution through practical work, not just presentations.<br><br>We welcome candidates from different backgrounds and can discuss reasonable adjustments during recruitment.</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><em>At Eucalyptus, we value individuals from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives, and we embrace the unique qualities each person brings. When you apply, please let us know of any reasonable adjustments you may need during the interview process. We use AI-assisted tools across our business to help our teams work more efficiently, including within our recruitment process. These tools support our team — all hiring decisions are made by real people, and every application is reviewed by a member of our recruitment team.</em></p></div> Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

We established Faculty in 2014 because we thought that AI would be the most important technology of our time. Since then, we’ve worked with over 350 global customers to transform their performance through human-centric AI. You can read about our real-world impact here.

We don’t chase hype cycles. We innovate, build and deploy responsible AI which moves the needle - and we know a thing or two about doing it well. We bring an unparalleled depth of technical, product and delivery expertise to our clients who span government, finance, retail, energy, life sciences and defence.

Our business, and reputation, is growing fast and we’re always on the lookout for individuals who share our intellectual curiosity and desire to build a positive legacy through technology.

AI is an epoch-defining technology, join a company where you’ll be empowered to envision its most powerful applications, and to make them happen.


About the team

 

Our Public Services Business Unit is committed to leveraging AI for the benefit of individual citizens and the public good.

From our work informing strategic government decisions, to optimising our NHS, through to reducing bureaucratic backlogs - we know that AI offers opportunities to drive improvements at every level of Government and we are proud to lead on some of the most impactful work happening in the sector.

Because of the nature of the work we do with our Government clients, you may need to be eligible for UK Security Clearance (SC) and willing to work on site with these clients from time to time.

 

About the role

 

As an Associate at Faculty, you will join a collaborative team scoping, building, and delivering impactful AI projects across Public Services. You will support work streams alongside our Public Services partners to ensure bespoke AI solutions are safe, evidence-backed, and practical.

 

We will look to you to nurture trusted client relationships, translate operational needs into clear delivery plans, and partner with technical teams to deploy tools that genuinely improve learning outcomes. This is an exciting opportunity to build your career at the forefront of safe, purposeful AI innovation.

 
 

What you'll be doing

 

  • Managing individual work streams to support the successful delivery and implementation of bespoke AI solutions

  • Working side-by-side with key stakeholders to understand critical mission challenges and user needs

  • Conducting open-source analysis to support the development of cutting-edge AI tools

  • Translating complex operational requirements into clear user stories for delivery and engineering teams.

  • Designing and testing workflows that support user-centric decision-making in high-stakes environments

  • Collaborating closely with technical teams to ensure projects run smoothly and solutions meet customer needs

  • Contributing to internal thought leadership, strategy, and capability development across the team

     

Who we're looking for

 

  • You demonstrate analytical thinking, can clearly communicate ideas, and synthesise complex information

  • You bring a passion for Applied AI safety, possibly from your experience within labs, academia, or evaluation/red teaming roles.

  • You have external client-facing experience and have built trusted relationships which have contributed to the overall success of projects/products

  • You’ve worked with technical teams

  • You understand Agile and related methodologies and the basis of iterative development and continuous delivery

  • You are thoughtful and proactive in ambiguous situations, with examples of when you’ve taken initiative and owned finding solutions to challenges

  • You’re excited and knowledgeable about the possibilities for innovation in AI Safety technology

 
 

Our interview process

  1. Talent Team Screen (30 mins)

  2. Introduction Interview (60 mins)

  3. Case Study Interview (60 mins)

Our Recruitment Ethos

We aim to grow the best team - not the most similar one. We know that diversity of individuals fosters diversity of thought, and that strengthens our principle of seeking truth. And we know from experience that diverse teams deliver better work, relevant to the world in which we live. We’re united by a deep intellectual curiosity and desire to use our abilities for measurable positive impact. We strongly encourage applications from people of all backgrounds, ethnicities, genders, religions and sexual orientations.

If you don’t feel you meet all the requirements, but are excited by the role and know you bring some key strengths, please don't hesitate in applying as you might be right for this role, or other roles. We are open to conversations about part-time hours.

A note on AI: we're happy for you to use it for research and interview prep, but please don't use it to generate answers during live interviews. title: Stage 2027 - IA/ML Engineer 50% R&D 50% Produit - Statistiques Bayésiennes
description: Ekimetrics est un leader mondial de l'efficacité marketing et commerciale et des solutions d'IA à l'échelle. Depuis 2006, nous aidons les entreprises à optimiser leur marketing et leurs opérations en combinant IA avec expertise business et technologique dans 4 domaines : Marketing & commercial effectiveness, Customer analytics, Operational excellence, ESG & sustainability.     Avec une équipe 100% internalisée et des bureaux à Paris, Londres, New York, Hong Kong et Shanghai, nous concevons des solutions sur mesure qui transforment les données en impact positif concret, grâce à une combinaison unique de technologie et de services.   Notre force est de déployer une IA à impact, à grande échelle. Notre mission : mobiliser cette puissance pour répondre aux défis les plus urgents de notre temps. Nous nous engageons pour une IA responsable et frugale, pour garantir un impact constant à grande échelle, et pour rester fidèles à nos valeurs et à notre ADN.   Contexte Les modèles marketing sont mis à jour à mesure que de nouvelles données arrivent : ventes hebdomadaires, résultats de campagnes, comportement des clients. Ils comprennent les marketing mix models (MMM), qui estiment le retour sur investissement de chaque canal média, ainsi que les modèles de demande et de promotion et les modèles de réponse client. Chaque mise à jour fait bouger les estimations, et la première question des métiers est : pourquoi ont-elles bougé ? Notre équipe a développé une méthode qui y répond de façon exacte pour les modèles bayésiens. Elle répartit le déplacement de toute quantité a posteriori entre des groupes d'observations : semaines, campagnes, régions, segments de clients ou expériences. La méthode est en cours d'évaluation par les pairs. Un premier prototype sur le MMM suit déjà une estimation semaine après semaine et lève une alerte quand une mise à jour la déplace plus que prévu. Sujet : pourquoi l'estimation a-t-elle bougé ? Attribution bayésienne en ligne pour les modèles marketing. Volet recherche (environ 3 mois) • Étendre l'attribution à l'apprentissage bayésien en ligne : mises à jour séquentielles, effets variables dans le temps (modèles linéaires dynamiques, filtre de Kalman), oubli des données anciennes. • Distinguer les trois causes d'un déplacement à chaque mise à jour : les nouvelles données, un vrai changement du marché et une erreur dans un flux de données. • Calibrer l'alerte de mise à jour : taux de fausses alertes et délai de détection, sur des données simulées dont la vérité est connue et sur des données publiques, pour le MMM et pour au moins un autre modèle marketing. • Rédiger un article destiné à un public de statistique ou de marketing science. Volet produit (environ 3 mois) • Transformer la méthode en un module Python testé, compatible avec nos outils de modélisation bayésienne (le MMM en premier). • Construire les sorties destinées aux métiers : une vue « ce qui a fait bouger l'estimation » et une alerte de mise à jour. • Les valider avec des consultants sur des cas réels, puis les documenter et les transmettre à l'équipe produit. Livrables attendus • Un article soumis à une revue ou une conférence à comité de lecture. • Un module Python testé et documenté, intégré à nos outils de modélisation. • Un guide court pour les consultants : comment lire et expliquer une attribution. Profil • Étudiant ou étudiante en dernière année de master ou d'école d'ingénieurs, en statistique, science des données ou probabilités. • Statistique bayésienne (prior, posterior, MCMC), et idéalement séries temporelles ou modèles à espace d'états. • Bonne maîtrise de Python (NumPy, une librairie de programmation probabiliste comme PyMC ou NumPyro), Git, tests unitaires. • Intérêt pour l'application de la statistique au marketing et pour l'explication des résultats à des non-spécialistes. Aucune connaissance préalable en marketing n'est requise. Rédaction claire en anglais. Pourquoi nous rejoindre ?   Chez Ekimetrics, vos idées comptent vraiment et vous appartiennent — à vous de leur donner vie. Nous cultivons un esprit entrepreneurial qui vous encourage à repousser les limites pour créer un impact significatif.    Mais il ne s’agit pas seulement de réussites individuelles : nous avançons ensemble, en nous enrichissant mutuellement. Ensemble, nous apprenons et progressons en continu , que ce soit à travers des parcours de carrière personnalisés, des projets stimulants, du mentorat, ou simplement grâce à la diversité des perspectives que chacun.e apporte.   Et surtout, nous croyons au plaisir dans le travail. Ekimetrics est un environnement stimulant et bienveillant, où chacun.e peut s’épanouir en étant pleinement soi-même.   En 2023, Ekimetrics a obtenu le statut d’entreprise à mission qui témoigne de notre ambition forte en matière de RSE. Notre raison d’être : Faire de la data science et de l’intelligence artificielle l’accélérateur de la transformation durable des organisations.   Nous sommes également certifiés Great Place to Work© en France, au Royaume-Uni et aux Etats-Unis, et notre bureau de Hong Kong a reçu le prix Best Companies to Work for in Asia 2023©.   Ekimetrics fait partie du classement French Tech 120 !Nous avons été sélectionnés par La French Tech pour rejoindre le prestigieux groupe des 120 scale-ups françaises les plus performantes, avec un fort potentiel pour devenir des leaders internationaux.     Vous aurez accès :   ·        Au catalogue de formation Eki.Academy qui contient des programmes qui vous feront monter en compétences sur nos solutions et nos métiers, des parcours apprenants sur notre plateforme digitale ainsi que des programmes dédiés à nos enjeux prioritaires, dont la sensibilisation aux sujets environnementaux avec la Climate School. ·        A une vie sportive, artistique, musicale, ludique, caritative et engagée : de notre salle de sport privatisée à nos expositions d’art, en passant par des jeux vidéo et des concerts, ou encore les défis RSE sur la plateforme Vendredi. Toutes ces initiatives sont portées par nos Eki.People ; ·        De nombreux évènements et séminaires pour rester proche de votre communauté ; ·        Des locaux chaleureux dans un quartier dynamique au cœur de Paris (Grands boulevards) ·        Une politique de télétravail flexible, avec 3 jours de présence obligatoire par tranche de 15 jours.   En tant qu’employeur, Ekimetrics offre à tous les mêmes opportunités d’accès à l’emploi sans distinction de genre, ethnicité, religion, orientation sexuelle, statut social, handicap et d’âge. Ekimetrics veille à développer un environnement de travail inclusif qui reflète la diversité dans ses équipes.  Find Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

title: Senior Account Executive - FRANCE
description: About Agicap   Created in Lyon in 2016 by three French entrepreneurs, Agicap is one of the fastest growing scale-ups in Europe, with over 8000 customers, 700 employees and fast revenue growth (7x between 2021 and 2024). Agicap is part of the French Tech 120, rewarding the most promising startups in France.   Agicap allows Finance teams of Mid-Market companies to efficiently manage and forecast their cash, pay their suppliers and get paid. By combining a Treasury Management System, and Accounts Payable and Accounts Receivable solutions into a single platform, Agicap aims at becoming the next leading Treasury Management platform for mid-market companies.   We have raised €145M since our creation, with prestigious VC funds including AVP, Greenoaks, Partech and BlackFin, with a last round in November 2024.   These additional resources further fuel our product innovation, allowing us to grow significantly and accelerate our international expansion across the world.   We believe our success comes from our highly passionate and dedicated teams, committed to building a company where people can grow and build their careers. We are constantly looking for great talents, aiming for excellence and ready to join our ambitious adventure!   Cash is the lifeblood of every business, and it's the number one priority for CFOs. As a Mid-Market Account Executive, your mission is to grow our business by winning new customers in the French mid-market segment. You own the full sales cycle, from discovery to signature, working with an SDR who feeds your pipeline. You don't just sell software: you position Agicap as a strategic partner for companies that want to transform how they manage cash. What you'll do Discovery & qualification Take ownership of the qualified opportunities passed on by the SDR team, from discovery through to signature. Run in-depth discovery sessions to understand each prospect's context, challenges, and cash flow needs. Identify concrete use cases for Agicap and build a clear ROI case tailored to each prospect. Work with your SDRs to define a sector-based development strategy and sharpen their outreach with your field feedback. Sales cycle management Deliver sharp product demos, based on the needs surfaced during discovery. Map all stakeholders and the buying process, and build strong relationships with CFOs, Finance Directors, and other C-level decision-makers. Present offers, negotiate terms, and support prospects all the way to signature, to meet and exceed your targets. Cross-functional collaboration Share structured feedback with the Marketing, Business Development, and Product teams to keep improving our go-to-market and our product. Work with Customer Success to ensure a smooth handover and a strong onboarding. Share your commercial expertise and ideas to help the whole team grow. Performance management Keep your pipeline data accurate and up to date in HubSpot. Review your performance regularly with your manager, spot areas to improve, and adjust your approach. What we are looking for: Around 5 years of experience in B2B sales, ideally in SaaS and in the mid-market segment, or experience in a finance department / audit / consulting / TS. A clear track record of meeting and exceeding sales targets. Strong discovery and consultative selling skills: you start from the prospect's problem, not the product. Comfortable selling to CFOs and Finance Directors. Strong analytical and synthesis skills, excellent verbal communication, and real intellectual curiosity. Discipline in using a CRM (HubSpot) and managing your pipeline. An entrepreneurial mindset: you're comfortable in a fast-moving environment and full of ideas. Fluent French and a good level of English. Nice to have: experience in treasury or finance software, an existing network in the French mid-market finance/CFO community, or experience in a scale-up or fintech. Why join Agicap An exceptional product-market fit, on a critical need: cash, the number one priority for CFOs. A strongly differentiated solution, a leader in Europe (G2), in a huge market. A strong culture: meritocracy, high standards, continuous learning, a European scale-up (>50% of revenue outside France). Real opportunities to grow, both in your role and across countries: at Agicap, former Sales are now managers, Ops, recruiters… across the Sales, Product, Marketing, and Customer Success teams. A close-knit, talented team with real team spirit. Package & benefits Attractive package: between €100K and €150K depending on profile and performance, with uncapped commissions. Swile meal vouchers: €11/day, with €6.50 covered by Agicap. 100% reimbursement of public transport. 1,000 m² offices in Vaise (Lyon 9ème). Latest-generation work equipment. Regular team events: afterworks, team lunches, football, running, monthly team building, and company offsites (the last one was on the privatised Île des Embiez in the South of France, for Agicap's 10th anniversary). AGICAP is committed to providing equal opportunities for everyone, and we foster an inclusive work environment that values diversity!     Find more English Speaking Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

raw.description:
About Scality

Scality builds data infrastructure software for enterprise AI, cyber resilience, and sovereign control at multi-petabyte to exabyte scale. Its AI Data Infrastructure platform reduces operational burden through AI-powered autonomous operations while aligning the right storage media, performance, and protection to each workload through human-approved lifecycle policies.
 
Built on CORE5 cyber resilience and open-code principles, Scality software delivers extreme performance, operational simplicity, and sustainable economics. 
 
The world's most demanding enterprises and government organizations depend on Scality to power AI initiatives, defend critical data, and build infrastructure that lasts for decades. Recognized as a leader by Gartner, Scality is where AI remembers, learns, and thinks. F
 
Follow us on LinkedIn. Visit www.scality.com and our blog.

Context & Motivation
A distributed storage cluster continuously emits telemetry at every level, from the platform and S3 service down to each server and disk. A failing disk, server or storage node leaves traces in these multivariate time series, from subtle shifts in a few metrics to system-wide disruption. Detecting and diagnosing these anomalies early is critical for:
  • Predictive maintenance: isolating or replacing a component before it impacts service
  • Faster diagnosis: pointing support engineers to the root cause, not just to an alert
  • Higher availability and durability of customer data
    • This internship is part of a joint research project between Scality and an INRIA research team. The project released SHAD (Scality High-dimensional Anomaly Detection), an open benchmark published at NeurIPS 2026 (Evaluations & Datasets Track). It contains 215 real 171-dimensional time series from Scality RING clusters, annotated for injected disk, server and storage-node failures. SHAD's baselines show the problem is far from solved. No detector handles every failure type, per-dimension attributions find root causes no better than chance, and off-the-shelf LLMs cannot interpret the anomalies. This internship builds on SHAD to close these gaps.

    More details on the project: scality.github.io/shad

    Your Mission
    As part of our R&D team and in close collaboration with INRIA researchers, you will develop AI models that detect, explain and interpret anomalies in storage-cluster telemetry. Your work will include: 
     
    1. State of the Art
    Review the literature and open-source projects on multivariate time series anomaly detection, root-cause attribution and LLM-based interpretation of time series. Also survey recent work on AI agents that automate research and experimentation. Starting points include SHAD and the TSB-AD benchmark. 
     
    2. Anomaly Detection & Diagnosis Models
    Design, train and benchmark models that improve on SHAD's baselines at each stage of the pipeline:
  • Detection that stays accurate across disk, server and storage-node failures (e.g., ensembles, hybrid models, time series foundation models)
  • Explanation: attributing each anomaly to the dimensions that actually cause it
  • Interpretation: turning detections into actionable diagnoses (failure type, criticality, affected component) 
  • Early detection of progressive degradations, the core of predictive maintenance
    •  
    3. Fleets of AI Agents for Research
    Set up and manage fleets of AI agents that run your studies at scale:
  • Design agent workflows that launch experiments, run benchmarks and compare methods
  • Orchestrate and monitor many agents working in parallel
  • Build safeguards for rigor: experiment tracking, reproducibility, independent verification of results
  • Assess what agent-driven research changes in practice: speed, coverage, failure modes
    •  
    4. Evaluation & Validation
    Evaluate every model with rigorous, reproducible protocols. Use them to:
  • Measure each stage with SHAD's metrics (VUS-PR for detection, NDCG for explanation, a questionnaire for interpretation)
    Quantify performance per failure family and scenario
  • Identify which approaches are ready to transfer to production monitoring

    • Expected Outcomes & Valorization
    Depending on results, the work may be valorized through:
     
  • A scientific publication with the Scality and INRIA researchers
  • New methods and baselines contributed to the open-source SHAD benchmark
  • Reusable agent-based research workflows for the R&D team

    • Technical Stack
  • Python (primary language for modeling, experimentation and analysis)
  • PyTorch and scikit-learn (deep learning and classical models)
  • SHAD benchmark (github.com/scality/shad) and TSB-AD (github.com/TheDatumOrg/TSB-AD) for data, detectors and evaluation
  • LLM-based AI agents and their orchestration tooling

    • Candidate Profile
  • Final-year student in a Master's program or Engineering school (Bac+5), in machine learning, data science or computer science
  • Solid foundations in machine learning; experience with time series or anomaly detection is a strong plus
  • Strong interest in LLMs and AI agents, and curiosity for new ways of doing research
  • Good Python skills and hands-on experience with a deep learning framework such as PyTorch
  • Rigorous and critical with experimental results, especially when agents produce them
  • Autonomous and curious, able to communicate results clearly in written and spoken English
  • Interest in distributed systems or storage is a plus, not a prerequisite

    • Work Environment
    You will join a fast-paced, lean AI R&D team. French and English is our primary working language. You will benefit from:
     
  • Mentorship from R&D engineers
  • Close collaboration with INRIA researchers working on time series anomaly detection
  • Access to real telemetry from Scality RING clusters and to the AI agent tooling the team uses for its studies
  • A high-trust environment where your findings will directly influence engineering decisions

    • Why Join Scality?
  • Work on a concrete research problem with real-world industrial impact
  • Build on a benchmark published at NeurIPS and contribute to open research
  • Practice a new way of doing research, with fleets of AI agents as research assistants
  • Be part of a team building infrastructure trusted by Fortune 500 companies
  • Potential to publish research or continue as a full-time engineer after the internship

title: CDI - Senior AI Engineer - Paris
description: <h2>Mission</h2> <p>De nouveaux modèles, ouverts ou fermés, sortent chaque mois : encore faut-il choisir ceux qui sont assez bons pour la production, et le démontrer. Applications et agents s’appuient sur les grands modèles de langage (LLM), et la partie modèle de ces systèmes est entre vos mains. Nos clients s’en servent pour répondre à leurs propres clients, traiter des documents et interroger leurs connaissances.</p> <p>Ce que le modèle voit, la manière dont il retrouve les connaissances, les outils qu’il peut appeler : ces choix vous appartiennent, de même que la mesure de la qualité des réponses. Le modèle retenu doit tenir l’objectif de coût et de qualité.</p> <p><strong>Ce poste est fait pour vous si vous voulez savoir si un système d’IA donne des réponses justes, et pas seulement s’il tourne.</strong></p> <p>Artefact accompagne les plus grandes entreprises du monde dans le déploiement de l’IA : 3 000 AI makers dans plus de 30 pays, plus de 1 000 clients. En France, le département Engineering réunit environ 300 personnes sous la responsabilité du CTO ; vous y rejoignez le chapter AI Applied Engineer, archétype AI Engineer.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <h2>Activités et responsabilités</h2> <p>Les Product Engineers construisent l’application autour du modèle ; le comportement du modèle à l’intérieur vous revient. Les Context &amp; Analytics Engineers préparent les connaissances que vos agents retrouvent, et les Platform Engineers exploitent le serving, le harness et l’observabilité sur lesquels vous vous appuyez.</p> <p>Avec l’AI Product Manager et les experts métier du client, une bonne réponse se définit, puis les résultats s’examinent ensemble. La relecture de code entre pairs et l’accompagnement des nouvelles recrues font partie du quotidien.</p> <p><strong>Vos responsabilités :</strong></p> <ul> <li>Construire des applications et des agents LLM : conception du contexte, appel d’outils, workflows multi-étapes.</li> <li>Concevoir la façon dont les agents exploitent les connaissances : requêtes de retrieval, re-ranking, citations.</li> <li>Construire des jeux et des pipelines d’évaluation : réponses de référence, scoring automatisé, relecture par des experts métier.</li> <li>Suivre la qualité des réponses en production et corriger ce qui se dégrade.</li> <li>Choisir les modèles selon la qualité, le coût et la latence ; faire du fine-tuning ou de la distillation sur un modèle plus petit quand le prompting ne suffit pas.</li> <li>Ajouter des garde-fous contre les mauvaises réponses, les fuites de données et le prompt injection.</li> <li>Traiter des documents avec des LLM : extraction, classification, résumés.</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <h2>Profil recherché</h2> <p><strong>Les indispensables :</strong></p> <ol> <li>Vous avez construit une application ou un agent qui appelle un LLM, et vous savez expliquer ce qui a fonctionné et ce qui a échoué.</li> <li>Votre code est testé et maintenable.</li> <li>Les coding agents font déjà partie de votre quotidien, et vous vérifiez ce qu’ils produisent.</li> <li>La qualité des sorties d’IA se mesure chez vous avec des jeux de test et des métriques, et vous savez limiter les hallucinations, le prompt injection et les fuites de données.</li> <li>Mettre en production une application LLM et la maintenir (déploiement, monitoring, coût, latence) n’a pas de secret pour vous.</li> <li>Le point de départ, pour vous, est le problème métier plutôt que le modèle ; reconnaître que l’IA n’est pas toujours le bon outil, et l’expliquer à des personnes non techniques, fait partie de votre pratique.</li> </ol> <p><strong>Un plus, pas un prérequis :</strong></p> <ul> <li>Du fine-tuning ou de la distillation de modèles de langage.</li> <li>Une formation en machine learning ou en statistiques, par exemple en data science.</li> <li>Des frameworks ou des protocoles d’agents, comme MCP.</li> <li>Des entrées multimodales : documents, images, voix.</li> <li>Des outils d’observabilité LLM : tracing, suivi des coûts.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Pas besoin de cocher toutes les cases pour postuler</strong> : si vous avez l’essentiel des indispensables et l’envie d’apprendre le reste, parlons-en.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <h2>Pourquoi nous rejoindre ?</h2> <p>Dans ce métier, la difficulté est moins de faire parler un modèle que de savoir s’il dit juste. L’AI Engineer répond à cette question par la mesure : jeux de test, évaluations, suivi en production, plutôt que par l’impression d’une démonstration réussie.</p> <p>Nous sommes des AI makers : l’IA se construit avec nos clients, pas seulement pour eux. Leurs enjeux deviennent les nôtres, et nos choix techniques s’expliquent dans le langage du métier. Les positions que nous prenons sont claires ; elles évoluent face aux faits, jamais sous la pression.</p> <p>Notre domaine change tous les mois, et ce rythme nous convient : les nouvelles technologies et les nouveaux secteurs s’apprennent vite, et les habitudes qui ne servent plus s’abandonnent sans regret. Devant un problème difficile, le réflexe est de le découper en étapes vérifiables, avec un haut niveau d’exigence sur le code comme sur les livrables.</p> <p>Quand il manque quelque chose, pour un client ou pour le chapter, nous le construisons. raw.description:
Who we are

Yubo is the instantly social, social app: the leading real-time social discovery platform where you can meet new people for friendship, crushes and community. Our mission is to help young adults find community - whoever they are, wherever they are and whenever they feel social. That's why we’re building a more spontaneous and human social world, one based on interaction, exploration and possibility.

We've pioneered a new way for Gen Z to socialize online, and with millions of active users, our goal is to redefine how we connect today and tomorrow. Our team is international, multicultural and deeply committed to its mission.

As the leading platform to socialize online, we have a special responsibility to build a safe digital space for our community. Safety is embedded in our DNA, and our proactive approach focuses on user protection, support, and education.

We also work closely with the broader technology industry to share our knowledge and NGOs create industry-leading child protection standards.

Join us in this exciting journey and help us shape the future of social interactions!

About this role


At Yubo, Product Managers have real ownership. They work in strong partnership with Product Designers and Engineering, shaping strategy and decisions from problem definition all the way to delivery, with direct and visible impact on both the product and the business.

We're looking for a Senior Product Manager to form that partnership with a Product Designer: a duo jointly responsible for the end-to-end experiences you ship together. You'll take ownership of a strategic product area, identify the biggest opportunities, and turn them into clear product bets on a product used by millions of people.

We're moving away from small, isolated feature launches toward bigger, end-to-end experiences tested at scale. You'll combine user understanding, data and strong product convictions to frame problems, shape solutions with Design and Engineering, and decide what to scale, iterate, or stop.

You'll also work closely with Data, Machine Learning, Brand Marketing and Trust & Safety on challenges ranging from recommendation and discovery to retention, safety, monetization and AI.

This role is particularly well suited to someone who enjoys balancing strategic thinking with hands-on execution, and who wants their decisions to have a visible impact on both user experience and business outcomes.

To make this dream duo work, we’re basing this role in Paris and looking for someone willing to come to the office once or twice a week.


Your responsibilities

  • Own a strategic product area from problem definition through delivery and post-launch iteration

  • Define product strategy and translate company objectives into clear priorities and measurable outcomes

  • Partner closely with Product Design and Engineering to shape end-to-end experiences rather than isolated features

  • Use data, research, user feedback, market insights, and product intuition to identify the problems worth solving

  • Turn opportunities into bold product bets, measure their impact, and decide whether to scale, iterate, or stop

  • Collaborate with Data, Machine Learning, Brand Marketing, Trust & Safety, and Legal to make informed product decisions

  • Balance user value, business impact, safety, and technical constraints when making trade-offs

  • Create alignment across stakeholders through clear problem framing, strong product conviction, and structured decision-making

Tools we use

  • Amplitude, SQL, Looker

  • Figma

  • Notion

  • Slack

  • Enterpret

  • AI tooling: Claude Code, ChatGPT Codex, Dust

Who you are

  • You have 4+ years of experience as a Product Manager, ideally within consumer mobile products and a startup or scale-up environment

  • You are comfortable owning a product area from problem definition through launch and iteration

  • You combine strong product intuition with analytical rigor

  • You know how to use data, research, user feedback, and experimentation to guide decisions

  • You start with the user problem rather than jumping straight to a feature or solution

  • You have the conviction to form a strong product point of view, make bold calls, and defend them

  • You enjoy working closely with Design and Engineering and leading through influence rather than hierarchy

  • You are comfortable making decisions with imperfect information and changing direction when the evidence tells you to

  • You know how to balance user experience with growth, engagement, monetization, safety, and long-term product health

  • Experience with social, community, social discovery, gaming, recommendation, or consumer subscription products is a plus

Within a month, you will

  • Get familiar with Yubo's product, users, business model, and product principles

  • Build relationships with your Product Designer and key stakeholders across Engineering, Data, Machine Learning, Brand Marketing, and Trust & Safety

  • Understand current product priorities, ongoing experiments, major user journeys, and the metrics behind them

  • Start contributing to discovery and product discussions

Within 3 months, you will

  • Take ownership of a defined product area and its key user and business problems

  • Establish a trusted way of working with your Product Designer and Engineering counterparts

  • Lead your first discovery work and turn your findings into clear product opportunities

  • Launch and analyze your first experiments, using their results to inform your next decisions

Within 6 months, you will

  • Own the strategy and key initiatives for your product area end to end

  • Lead ambitious product bets that rethink meaningful parts of the user experience rather than isolated features

  • Drive measurable progress on outcomes such as retention, engagement, recommendation quality, monetization, or trust

  • Use data, user insight, and experimentation to decide what to scale, iterate, stop, or explore next

  • Raise the bar on product thinking, experimentation, and decision-making across Yubo

The recruitment process

  • Phone screen with Anita, Talent Acquisition

  • First interview with Sacha, our CEO

  • Product case study and debrief with Product Managers

  • Cultural fit assessments

  • And if everything went well, an offer!

What we offer

  • A highly competitive salary range as well as equity in the company

  • A hybrid work policy with up to two days of on-site presence per week at an amazing office and monthly team events to enjoy.

  • We also cover fees for external professional events and meetups (Android Makers, etc…)

  • Great health insurance coverage for both you and your family by Alan, fully paid for by Yubo !

  • Numerous benefits for parents: additional parental leave, easy access to nurseries and daycare facilities in France.

Our approach to privacy & safety

As part of your role, you may handle tools and features involving personal data. We expect all employees to demonstrate strong awareness of privacy and safety issues, and to actively support our Privacy & Safety by Design efforts.

Join Yubo and help shape the future of Social Discovery while enjoying a culture that values flexibility, well-being, and impact.

Here’s how we live our mission every day:

You own the impact: Step up, adapt, and make it matter

Unconventionally Smart: Hack with intent, borrow smart, build better

Be Bold & Resilient: Raise your head, break barriers, keep moving forward

One team, one mission: No egos, no passengers, just shared wins

 

Trust & Flexibility: Our hybrid model calls for only two office days a month; the rest is up to the rhythm that works best for you.

 

Enjoy Top-notch Benefits

Culture is central at Yubo, hence the numerous benefits:

Cool Workplace: enjoy our amazing Parisian office and our many hybrid work options

Team Activities: participate in get-togethers, events, and team-building activities

Family-Friendly: we support parents with childcare options and family-friendly policies

Wellness Programs: benefit from comprehensive health insurance, wellness programs, sports classes, and mental well-being initiatives

Business Unit dédiée à une marque leader de la grande consommation (FMCG) et contribuerez à ses stratégies d’influence en France.</p> <p>Aux côtés de l’équipe Influence, en lien avec les équipes clients, média, créatives et les agences partenaires, vous participerez à des campagnes pour des marques iconiques, entre création de contenu, entertainment et pop culture : musique, gaming, sport, food ou lifestyle.</p> <p><strong><br>Vos missions :</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Contribuer aux stratégies d’influence :</strong> participer à la construction des recommandations stratégiques et créatives, proposer des idées d’activation et assurer une veille sur les tendances, la culture Gen Z, les usages des plateformes sociales, les créateurs émergents et les activations concurrentes.<br><br></li> <li><strong>Participer au casting des</strong><strong> créateurs de contenu :</strong> identifier des profils, de la nano-influence aux célébrités, et analyser leurs performances, leurs audiences, leur univers éditorial et leur affinité avec les marques.<br><br></li> <li><strong>Accompagner le suivi opérationnel des campagnes :</strong> participer à la rédaction des briefs, au suivi des agences partenaires, à la préparation des scripts et contenus soumis à validation, aux rétroplannings ainsi qu’au suivi budgétaire, administratif et contractuel.<br><br></li> <li><strong>Participer aux activations et aux productions de contenus :</strong> accompagner l’équipe lors des tournages, événements, expériences immersives et activations terrain avec les créateurs pistes d’optimisation, et explorer l’apport des outils d’intelligence artificielle dans nos réflexions et méthodes de travail.</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Compétences requises :</strong></p> <ul> <li>Formation Bac +4/+5 en communication, marketing ou publicité, à la recherche d’une alternance.</li> <li>Un vif intérêt pour l’influence, l’entertainment et la pop culture, et une bonne connaissance des créateurs de contenu et des plateformes sociales (Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, Twitch, Snapchat).</li> <li>Curiosité, créativité, réactivité, rigueur et sens de l’organisation pour suivre plusieurs sujets en parallèle.</li> <li>Aisance rédactionnelle et relationnelle, esprit d’analyse et de synthèse, bonne maîtrise de PowerPoint et d’Excel, et bon niveau d’anglais (B2 souhaité).</li> </ul> <p><strong>Un plus :</strong> la connaissance d’outils de marketing d’influence (comme CreatorIQ) et de social listening.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Pourquoi nous rejoindre :</strong></p> <ul> <li>Contribuer à des campagnes d’influence d’envergure nationale pour des marques iconiques à dimension internationale.</li> <li>Évoluer au sein d’une Business Unit dédiée, dans une équipe pluridisciplinaire.</li> <li>Travailler aux côtés de créateurs de contenu, d’agences partenaires et d’experts média et créatifs.</li> <li>Acquérir une vision complète du marketing d’influence, de la stratégie à la mesure de la performance.</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>La vie chez WPP Media et ses avantages</strong></p> <p>Notre engagement à façonner l'avenir des médias se manifeste par un soutien actif au développement professionnel de nos talents, les aidant à atteindre leur plein potentiel. Cette démarche s'accompagne d'une vision responsable dans nos stratégies d'investissement médiatique, reflétant ainsi notre double priorité : valoriser nos collaborateurs tout en adoptant des pratiques durables dans notre secteur. Les réussites et expertises des équipes sont régulièrement mises en lumière lors d'événements fédérateurs qui ponctuent également les moments clés de l'année, renforçant ainsi notre culture d'entreprise collaborative et diversifiée.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Ce que nous offrons&nbsp;:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Une <strong>expérience professionnelle unique</strong> au sein d'une compagnie média renommée, où vous pourrez acquérir des compétences précieuses et développer votre réseau professionnel.</li> <li>L'opportunité de travailler avec des <strong>clients de premier plan</strong> et de contribuer à la création de campagnes publicitaires de grande envergure.</li> <li>Un <strong>accompagnement personnalisé</strong> pour tous les Padawans (stagiaires/alternants chez WPP Media) de votre intégration à votre départ … ou pas&nbsp;!</li> <li><strong>Des déjeuners, cafés, afterworks</strong> ainsi que différents évènements qui rythmeront votre année chez nous.</li> <li>Un <strong>campus</strong> à Levallois-Perret qui rassemble toutes les agences WPP (WPP Media et ses sœurs) au terminus de la ligne 3&nbsp;!</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Process de recrutement</strong></p> <ul> <li>Entretien avec l’équipe recrutement : Un premier pré-entretien téléphonique de 5mn, puis un entretien de 30mn en visio-conférence par un membre de notre équipe recrutement. title: Outbound Account Development Representative - France
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><span style="font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif;"><strong>Who we are</strong></span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 300; font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif;">Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 300; font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif;">Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.</span></p></div><p><strong>About the Role</strong></p> <p>As an Account Development Representative (ADR) at Samsara, you will be trained, both on the job and with formal training programs led by a world-class team of sales professionals, to take on your next role as closing Account Executive.&nbsp;</p> <p>On a daily basis, you will be responsible for sourcing pipelines for our EMEA business,&nbsp; generating opportunities via outbound outreach.&nbsp;</p> <p>We have offices in Munich, Paris and Amsterdam and we offer remote working from Germany, France, The Netherlands and London. Our European headquarters are based in London.</p> <p><strong>This is a remote position open to candidates based in France, Germany, The Netherlands and United Kingdom. This position requires working hours in CEST. Relocation assistance will not be provided for this role.</strong></p> <p><strong>You should apply if:&nbsp;</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>You want to impact the industries that run our world: </strong>Your efforts will result in real-world impact—helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.</li> <li><strong>You are the architect of your own career: </strong>If you put in the work, this role won’t be your last at Samsara. Successful ADRs can see promotion to a closing role in two years or less.</li> <li><strong>You love talking to people: </strong>In this role, you will average 60+ calls to prospective customers daily.</li> <li><strong>You have an innate curiosity about how businesses work: </strong>One day you’ll meet with someone in waste management and the next you may be learning about the inner workings of a food distribution center. Our top sales team members seek to learn the ins and outs of the businesses they support to make a larger impact.</li> <li><strong>You treat rejection as a learning experience:</strong> In this role, you will get hung up on and you will get told no. You need to have the resilience to pick up the phone again and again to sell Samsara’s mission.</li> <li><strong>You want to be with the best: </strong>Samsara’s high-performance Sales culture means you’ll be surrounded by the best and challenged to go farther than you have before.</li> </ul> <h4><strong>In this role, you will:</strong>&nbsp;</h4> <ul> <li>Drive pipeline through personalized outreach to prospects via phone, emails and Linkedin</li> <li>Have the opportunity to to participate in trade/shows events to represent the Samsara brand and connect with prospective customers and partners.</li> <li>Become a product expert and learn the Samsara way of selling</li> <li>Keep meticulous records of interactions with accounts in our CRM (Salesforce.com)</li> <li>Champion, role model, and embed Samsara’s cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices</li> </ul> <p><strong>Minimum requirements for the role:</strong></p> <ul> <li>1-3 years professional experience, ideally in customer facing roles</li> <li>6-12 months sales experience as a title: Head of Operations
description: At Zoomo, our vision is to transition every commercial urban mile to light electric vehicles (LEVs) to build sustainable and more equitable cities. To that end, we are building the world’s most convenient, affordable, and safe e-bike platform. In 4 years Zoomo has helped transition millions of urban miles to light electric vehicles, built a team of >200 world class engineers, operators, sales staff and vehicle repair technicians; developed and deployed the world's best last mile delivery electric bikes and fleet management software; and successfully deploys these solutions around the world. We operate across the USA, UK, Europe, Canada and Australia. Zoomo vehicles are used by major players in the food, grocery and parcel delivery segments with partners including UberEats, Doordash, JustEat Takeaway, Deliveroo, Domino’s, Pizza Hut, Amazon, FedEx, Getir, Ocado, GoPuff and many more. The Role We’re hiring the most senior leader in France, reporting to the COO, to own market performance end-to-end: operational excellence, growth, and P&L outcomes. You’ll shape and improve our physical operations (fleet, workshop, retail), lead a hands-on team on the ground, and drive pragmatic growth initiatives (pricing, channels, partnerships) to build demand. This role requires an entrepreneurial operator with strong ownership, comfortable both running day-to-day operations and identifying opportunities to improve and grow the business. You can expect to: Drive local growth strategy: identify demand constraints and run pragmatic tests (pricing, offers, channels, local partnerships) with clear measurement. Stabilise and scale core operations (workshop + retail + fleet logistics). Expand capacity thoughtfully as demand grows, ensuring process discipline and cost control. Deliver excellent B2B operations (SLA, onboarding, servicing, reporting) while maintaining focus on B2C growth (majority of the business). Own P&L rhythm for France: budgeting, forecasting, cost control, and trade-offs that protect unit economics while enabling growth. Hire, coach, and performance-manage a high-accountability frontline team; develop 1-2 strong leads to strengthen local leadership depth.  Lead safety initiatives and programs to ensure we continue to keep customers and employees safe at scale. Own the weekly operating cadence and core KPIs for France. Ensure pragmatic processes that keep the operation in control are implemented and digested by the team. Create a high-performance culture: clear ownership, measurable goals, fast problem-solving, and strong talent development. Act as the senior leader in France, partnering with central functions (Ops, Growth, Finance, Revenue, Tech, People) to set priorities, ensure support and deliver results. Handle local ‘GM admin’ with limited support: vendors, facilities topics, contracts coordination, and operational bureaucracy - solve problems end-to-end. Requirements 5+ years of experience managing frontline operations in a fast-paced, physical environment (last-mile, mobility, retail ops, field services, logistics). Proven track record improving measurable outcomes (throughput, quality, cost, availability, customer metrics) via hands-on leadership and process discipline. You have hired and led frontline teams; comfortable with performance management and raising the bar in junior teams. You are an entrepreneurial operator with a high-ownership mindset who thrives in ambiguous, decentralised international environments, proactively building solutions and driving impact without the need for constant direction. You have a bias for action and experimentation: identify levers, run tests (incl. pricing/channel changes), measure impact, iterate fast. Comfortable switching between floor-level detail (workshop/retail) and business planning (forecasting, stakeholder updates). Basic P&L experience: has managed or strongly influenced revenue and cost lines; can budget/forecast and make trade-offs. Comfortable handling administrative complexity and operational bureaucracy; can coordinate vendors/contracts/facilities issues end-to-end. Experience in a scale-up or transformation environment with ambiguity and limited structure; can build order without heavy support. Humility is something that comes naturally to you. You’re a born collaborator and you care about getting to the right answer more than who came up with it. Benefits We offer you the chance to be part of a team at the cutting edge of the world’s electrification journey, including: Working with a switched on team that strives to make the streets greener and serve the rider Basic Salary of 70,000€ - 80000€ per annum (depending on experience) Benefit from the company's success, through equity options - giving you ownership in and financial upside to the company’s long term success Global and country-specific benefits packages Flexible working that is focussed on the delivery of OKRs Monthly team outings & events Get to know our product by using one of our e-bikes Annual learning and development allowance Mental wellbeing support Zoomers currently represent 45 nationalities and we celebrate diversity and inclusion with equal opportunities for all. #LI-ONSITE Find more English Speaking Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

Des votre arrivee, vous realiserez un diagnostic de l'existant et proposerez a la Direction une roadmap claire, priorisee et datee permettant d'organiser les differentes etapes de la candidature. Identifier les actions necessaires et proposer leur planification. Rediger les documents, procedures, engagements et supports requis. Collecter et organiser les elements de preuve. Suivre la roadmap et preparer le dossier de candidature. Deposer le dossier apres validation de la Direction. Preparer l'audit et assurer le suivi des eventuelles demandes complementaires jusqu'au processus de labellisation. Vous travaillerez en collaboration avec le Chef, la Directrice de l'Hebergement et l'Assistante de direction. Des le debut du stage : satisfaction client & preparation de la saison 2027 La fermeture hivernale sera mise a profit pour analyser l'ensemble des retours clients de la saison 2026 afin d'identifier les ameliorations pouvant etre engagees avant la reouverture. Analyser les enquetes Qualitelis 2026, les verbatims et les principales plateformes d'avis clients. Identifier les points forts, irritants recurrents et principaux axes d'amelioration. Realiser et finaliser les check-lists par poste et par shift. Integrer les enseignements issus de l'analyse de la satisfaction client. Mettre les outils en coherence avec les engagements Clef Verte. Rediger et proposer les evolutions necessaires avant l'arrivee des equipes. A la reouverture : sensibiliser les equipes Creer des supports de sensibilisation adaptes aux differents metiers. Participer a la presentation des engagements Clef Verte. Sensibiliser les equipes aux bonnes pratiques environnementales. Creer des supports pratiques concernant notamment le tri et la gestion des dechets, les consommations d'eau et d'energie et les achats responsables. Integrer ces engagements dans les documents et outils operationnels destines aux collaborateurs. At Tandem, you'll drive how our platform connects with the external systems used across French and European healthcare - owning and driving some of the most critical technical initiatives we have. You'll be based in our France office, working alongside the local team, in close collaboration with our central Integrations team in Stockholm. A big part of the role is deeply understanding both sides: the capabilities and constraints of external systems, and those of our own platform. From that understanding, you'll find ways to integrate them and shape concrete proposals for how integrations should work, together with external partners.

You move fast, but not carelessly. You know how to break down complex problems, prioritize what matters, and keep momentum across multiple workstreams. You're comfortable going deep technically when needed, understanding APIs, data flows, and system constraints, while still keeping the bigger product picture in mind.


This is a high-impact role where you'll not only deliver projects, but shape how we build and scale technical products at Tandem.


What You'll Do

  • Lead integration work with external partners and healthcare systems, ensuring high-quality, scalable implementations.

  • Map external systems against our own platform and propose concrete integration designs to external partners.

  • Act as the central point of coordination between engineering, partnerships, and external stakeholders, bridging the local team in France and the integrations team in Stockholm.

  • Translate complex technical requirements into clear priorities, plans, and deliverables.

  • Work closely with engineers to understand APIs, data models, and system architecture, and ensure solutions are robust and aligned with our platform.

  • Identify bottlenecks, manage dependencies, and keep projects moving at high velocity.

  • Build and improve how we work - establishing processes, templates, and frameworks for integrations and technical delivery.

  • Ensure strong visibility across stakeholders - tracking progress, surfacing risks, and communicating clearly.

  • Support our sales organisation in answering technical questions from our customers.

What You Bring

  • Experience as a Technical Project Manager or similar role in a SaaS, platform, or healthtech environment.

  • Strong ability to drive complex, cross-functional initiatives involving both internal teams and external stakeholders.

  • Technical fluency - comfortable discussing APIs, authentication, integrations, and system design with engineers.

  • Proven ability to manage multiple workstreams without losing clarity or momentum.

  • Ability to anticipate, assess, and manage risk in projects, from scoping through to delivery.

  • Strong communication skills, you can translate technical complexity into clear decisions and direction.

  • A product mindset - you care about building the right thing, not just delivering on time.

  • Native level french speaking.

Bonus Points

  • Experience in tech sales, enterprise sales, or enterprise software delivery

  • Experience working with healthcare systems or regulated environments

  • Familiarity with FHIR, HL7, or other healthcare data standards

  • Experience working with platform or API products

  • Some hands-on technical experience (e.g. scripting, debugging, light coding)

  • Experience scaling integration processes or working with multiple external partners

Location

We believe the best ideas happen when we're together. This role is based in our Paris office, where you will work primarily on-site with the local team, while collaborating closely with colleagues at our HQ in Stockholm.

How to Apply

We adopt a continuous selection process, so please make sure to apply with your CV in English.

Our interview process consists of 4 stages:

  • Screening interview with Talent Acquisition

  • Technical interview with some of our Engineering team

  • Follow-up interview with one of our Team Leads

  • Home case and presentation at our Paris office - Join us for a lunch, a discovery meeting and a presentation to experience our culture firsthand, collaborate with our team, and see how you work in action.

Culture at Tandem

At Tandem, we move fast, think big, and take ownership. We're a high-performing, diverse team with a shared drive to change the future of healthcare - and we’re just getting started.

Our culture is built on action, ambition, and learning. You'll be trusted to take the lead, challenge yourself, and make an impact from day one. We believe real growth happens when you're stretched, supported, and surrounded by smart, passionate teammates who want to win together.

Even though we’re spread across countries, we come together often in Sweden for team meetings, social events, and offsites - blending global reach with real human connection.

We hire for talent, potential, and attitude - valuing different backgrounds and fresh perspectives. Great ideas come from everywhere, and we’re building a team that reflects the world we want to change.

Tandem handles sensitive patient data and will conduct a background check before hiring any candidate.

operating AI-powered products, using LLMs, RAG and AI Agents</li> <li>Experience applying AI to software development workflows, such as code review, technical design, testing, documentation, cross-functional teams</li> <li>Curiosity, pragmatism and a strong product mindset, with a passion for turning real developer pain points into useful AI-powered solutions</li> <li>Feel free to add a link to your GitHub in your CV so we can better understand what you have built and worked on!</li> </ul> <h2>&nbsp;</h2> <h2><strong>Tech Stack</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Java, Python, TypeScript</li> Vous serez le/la partenaire RH de confiance des responsables Customer Care, en étroite collaboration avec votre binôme, avec pour mission d'aider à façonner l'organisation, pas seulement de la soutenir, et de faire avancer la transformation de manière pragmatique et terrain. Ce fonctionnement en binôme nécessite un fort esprit d'équipe, une réelle capacité de collaboration et l'envie de construire ensemble des solutions adaptées aux enjeux du business. Ce rôle offre une combinaison rare d'influence stratégique et de proximité opérationnelle réelle. Vous travaillerez directement avec les managers et responsables Customer Care sur les sujets qui définissent la performance et la croissance durable : design organisationnel, coaching managérial, talent et succession, cycles de rémunération et situations individuelles complexes. Si vous êtes stimulé(e) par des environnements où les priorités évoluent vite et où les décisions se prennent avec données et discernement, vous trouverez ici la portée et l'autonomie pour avoir un impact visible. raw.description:
Rejoindre Doctolib en tant que HR Business Partner pour les équipes Customer Care en France, c'est rejoindre une équipe RH et travailler en binôme sur ce périmètre. Vous serez le/la partenaire RH de confiance des responsables Customer Care, en étroite collaboration avec votre binôme, avec pour mission d'aider à façonner l'organisation, pas seulement de la soutenir, et de faire avancer la transformation de manière pragmatique et terrain. Ce fonctionnement en binôme nécessite un fort esprit d'équipe, une réelle capacité de collaboration et l'envie de construire ensemble des solutions adaptées aux enjeux du business.

Ce rôle offre une combinaison rare d'influence stratégique et de proximité opérationnelle réelle. Vous travaillerez directement avec les managers et responsables Customer Care sur les sujets qui définissent la performance et la croissance durable : design organisationnel, coaching managérial, talent et succession, cycles de rémunération et situations individuelles complexes. Si vous êtes stimulé(e) par des environnements où les priorités évoluent vite et où les décisions se prennent avec données et discernement, vous trouverez ici la portée et l'autonomie pour avoir un impact visible.

Rattaché(e) directement à la HR Director France, vous travaillerez auprès d'une population Customer Care dans un environnement international et en mouvement constant. Vous serez à la fois stratégique et opérationnel(le) : vous façonnerez le design organisationnel, piloterez des projets de transformation à grande échelle et accompagnerez les managers dans leurs défis de croissance. Vous bénéficierez d'une réelle autonomie pour laisser votre empreinte sur la façon dont nous construisons et développons l'excellence au sein de nos équipes Customer Care.

Vos responsabilités incluent, mais ne sont pas limitées à :

Transformation business & efficacité organisationnelle

  • Collaborer avec les managers et responsables Customer Care pour influencer les décisions clés en matière de design organisationnel, de gestion de la performance et d'initiatives de changement, pas seulement les exécuter

  • Allier conseil stratégique et soutien opérationnel, en restant proche du terrain tout en accompagnant les managers dans la complexité et en pilotant des transformations significatives

Conseil RH & gestion du changement

  • Coacher et guider les managers pour améliorer l'efficacité collective et la santé organisationnelle de leurs équipes

Excellence RH

  • Développer une compréhension approfondie du business et de la culture Doctolib, et être l'ambassadeur(rice) du modèle opérationnel et des produits People

  • Contribuer à la meilleure expérience collaborateur possible en apportant un soutien RH de premier plan aux équipes Customer Care

  • Piloter les cycles RH de bout en bout, performance, revues de talent, rémunération, avec rigueur ; élaborer les plans de développement, de rétention et de succession qui élèvent le niveau sur l'ensemble du périmètre

  • Construire et entretenir des relations solides avec les équipes transversales, TA, L&D, C&B, Juridique, tout en assurant l'alignement entre les besoins locaux et les initiatives People globales

Les qualités attendues en tant que HRBP

Avant de poursuivre votre lecture, si vous n'avez pas le profil exact décrit ci-dessous, mais que vous pensez que cette description de poste correspond à vos compétences et à vos aspirations, nous vous encourageons tout de même à postuler.

Vous pourrez être le prochain membre de notre équipe si vous :

  • Maîtrisez le français et l'anglais, niveau professionnel, pour évoluer dans notre environnement international, avec une solide connaissance du droit social français

  • Justifiez d'au moins 4 ans d'expérience RH, dans des environnements de transformation ou en forte croissance, avec une pratique du partenariat business

  • Excellez dans l'influence sans autorité : vous construisez de vraies relations partenariales au-delà de la simple application des politiques RH, challengez vos interlocuteurs de façon constructive et pilotez le changement grâce à des insights data-driven

  • Vous vous épanouissez dans des environnements rapides et ambigus, avec de solides compétences en gestion du changement et la capacité à piloter des projets complexes impliquant de multiples parties prenantes

  • Faites preuve d'un solide sens du business et d'une orientation terrain : vous comprenez les dynamiques organisationnelles, parlez le langage des responsables Customer Care et savez concilier conformité et solutions pragmatiques favorisant la performance

  • Vous avez une expérience dans des fonctions Customer Care ou commerciales, et comprenez les enjeux spécifiques de talent et de performance de ces équipes

title: Senior Reinforcement Learning Engineer
description: Gravis Robotics is a high-growth Series A start-up backed by SoftBank, bringing Physical AI to the construction industry, turning heavy construction machines into autonomous robots.  Gravis began as an ETH Zurich spin-out, and our unique combination of learning-based automation and augmented remote control lets one operator safely conduct a fleet of earthmoving machines in a gamified environment.    Backed by deep robotics research and now deployed across multiple countries with leading construction and equipment partners, our team is rapidly growing to bring this technology to a trillion-dollar industry.    The Gravis RACK is a machine-agnostic retrofit kit that adds autonomy to excavators and wheel loaders from 10 to 100+ tonnes: LiDAR and camera sensing, GNSS RTK, networking hardware and rugged edge compute that works offline. Paired with the Slate tablet and our Copilot software, it lets an operator run a machine manually, with AI assistance, or fully autonomously.   About the Job   The autonomy team at Gravis builds autonomous systems for excavators operating in real construction environments. You will build control modules that run on many different machines , across many sites, with different soil conditions. We’re looking for a roboticist with data driven planning and/or control background, deep python expertise and good level of C++ proficiency.   To be successful in this role you should have experience working with real robots, tackling the challenges of sim2real transfer, and deploying robotic systems in a production environment.     What you will do Learning-Based Planning and Control for Real Systems   Develop data driven planning and control systems for autonomous excavation that generalize across machine models and soil conditions Contribute to  simulation improvements that reduce or address the sim2real gap Define data collection and curation pipelines for incorporating real data in policy training  Design experiments focused on continuous performance and robustness improvements. Explore the usage of adaptive and online reinforcement learning in deployed systems Provide mentorship and supervision for junior team members, interns, and students.   System Integration   Integrate learned components into a larger software stack Collaborate with excavation and motion planning engineers Build tools for analysing and evaluating the behavior of learned components What we’re looking for We recognize that excellent candidates come from diverse backgrounds with various combinations of skills. If you meet most of the core qualifications below, we highly encourage you to apply. Core qualifications 2–5 years industry experience developing Reinforcement learning systems for control and/or planning and deploying them on real robots with a customer. If you only have experience with simulation, you’re most likely not a good fit for this position. Experience with GPU accelerated simulation environments (e.g. IsaacSim/IsaacLab, CARLA, MuJoCo) Strong Python skills and experience with PyTorch or similar libraries Proficiency in C++ Comfortable debugging real-world system behavior Ability and willingness to travel as required by business projects.  Great-to-Have Skills & Experience Experience with hydraulic machinery Experience with supervised learning or imitation learning Research experience in reinforcement learning Experience deploying robotic systems at scale (e.g. hundreds of units) Familiarity with ROS or similar robotics frameworks Experience with feature-flagged deployments, staged rollouts, or long-lived platforms Experience with data curation for ML applications Experience guiding, mentoring, or leading junior colleagues, students, or project teams.  Familiarity with or interest in utilizing AI coding tools.  This Role is a Great Fit If You are passionate about building systems that work reliably in the real world You want to help build a long-lived excavation planning and control system intended to scale and positively impact the entire construction industry.  You are comfortable working with the realities of imperfect data and noisy measurements. You have a keen interest in bridging the sim2real gap and understanding the differences between simulation and physical environments.  You are excited to help drive technical direction in a growing team transitioning from prototyping to the product stage. You value a collaborative team culture rooted in thoughtful design, creative thinking, mutual respect, and pragmatism.  Don't meet every requirement? If you're enthusiastic about this role but your experience doesn't match every qualification, we still encourage you to apply. You might be the perfect candidate for this or other positions. This is an opportunity to join a dynamic and versatile team, and to be part of a young startup that will revolutionize heavy construction.   Gravis Robotics offers a fair market salary and a working location in the vibrant city of Zurich. As a forward-facing startup, we understand that work-life balance and flexibility are important considerations for many professionals:   If you are a highly qualified candidate with the requisite skills and experience, we encourage you to apply and discuss your preferred working arrangement during the interview process. Gravis is an equal opportunity employer.   We are committed to building an inclusive and diverse team, and do not discriminate based upon race, color, ancestry, national origin, religion, sex, sexual orientation, age, gender identity, gender expression, disability, veteran status, or other legally protected characteristics. We are an international team that is working to solve problems with a global impact: to facilitate efficient communication and collaboration, proficiency in English is a requirement for all roles.       Find more English Speaking Jobs in Switzerland on Arbeitnow
