title: Leader, EMEA Product Support
description: We are rebuilding biotech for the AI era. When a breakthrough is delayed, the world waits. Getting a molecule from discovery to patients, or a crop from lab to field, involves thousands of slow, manual, disconnected steps. AI has the potential to change this, compressing decades of R&D work into years. But that only happens when clean, structured scientific data and AI are built into how science gets done. Benchling is the AI platform for biotech R&D. Scientists use Benchling to design experiments, capture structured data, and run AI agents and models directly in their workflows. Over 200,000 scientists around the world trust Benchling to power their most important work, from academic labs to Sanofi, Moderna, and more than half of the world's top 50 biopharma. We’re building an AI scientist for our customers. We can’t do that if we haven’t built the muscle ourselves. AI fluency is the foundation we build on; it's core to how we work, and we're committed to helping every new hire integrate it into their day-to-day. As part of our interview process, you'll complete a brief AI-focused exercise or discussion so we can understand how you think about and use AI to drive impact in your role. Feel free to reference any tools, platforms, or workflows you use today. ROLE OVERVIEW The Leader, EMEA Product Support role manages Benchling support in EMEA. As the team leader (a player-coach role), you’ll manage Product Support Analalyts in Europe and spend roughly 40% of your time directly owning customer issues and our most complex escalations. This role owns live customer-impacting incidents for enterprise pharma and biotech customers, helps shape an AI-first support model, and sits close to CX leadership. Working closely with our Global Support and CX Leadership Teams, you’ll combine team leadership, incident management, and thoughtful AI adoption to help scale a modern, efficient Support organization. RESPONSIBILITIES Lead and coach your team: run daily regional support operations including prioritization and resourcing, hold regular team meetings and career growth conversations, and build a culture where people feel supported and excited to grow. Partner with the Incident Center of Excellence to mature the incident process (post-incident reviews, closing action items, communication playbooks, severity-based response criteria), and help build and run a sustainable off-hours coverage model, including personally rotating in as an escalation responder. Analyze support metrics (volume, severity trends, time-to-resolution, comms timeliness) to inform staffing and process decisions, and report trends to CX leadership. Drive consistent adoption of AI tools across support workflows, piloting ways to reduce ticket-handling time, surface account context automatically, and free up analyst time for higher-value work. Collaborate with Build, Product, Technical Account Managers, Customer Success, and Professional Services on customer issues and incidents, keep help content and product knowledge current, and represent support at customer-facing events as needed. Work the queue alongside your team: own complex, high-priority, and escalated tickets, serve as a first-line contact for regional escalations, and model the troubleshooting, investigation, and communication standards you expect from others. QUALIFICATIONS Experienced leader who coaches with empathy and stays close to the work, with 1+ years of management experience and 5+ years of SaaS support or professional services, or demonstrated leadership, including assigning ticket work and managing queues and resources. Able to personally troubleshoot and resolve complex customer issues. Working knowledge of support and incident tooling and best practices for technical support environments (e.g. Salesforce, Zendesk, JIRA, PagerDuty, or equivalent), plus genuine enthusiasm for AI in support, ideally with hands-on experience piloting or driving adoption. Sound judgment under pressure: prioritizing by urgency, severity, and customer health context, and skilled in customer-facing crisis communication, including what to say, when, and to whom during a live incident, and how to translate root cause into clear RCAs/ISNs. Experience with enterprise-grade support: managing high-stakes accounts holistically, building trust with sophisticated customers, and thinking beyond individual ticket resolution. Strong communicator and customer advocate with a bias toward action, comfortable working independently across departments, remote teams, and external stakeholders. Bachelor’s degree in a life sciences related field recommended (biology, microbiology, genetics, biotechnology, neurology, etc.); research or lab experience is a big plus. Based in the Zurich area, or willing to relocate, and able to work on-site in our Zurich office Monday, Tuesday, and Thursday. HOW WE WORK We offer a flexible hybrid work arrangement that prioritizes in-office collaboration. Employees are expected to be on-site 3 days per week (Monday, Tuesday, and Thursday). #LI-Hybrid #LI-Remote #BI-Hybrid #BI-Remote Benchling welcomes everyone. We believe diversity enriches our team so we hire people with a wide range of identities, backgrounds, and experiences. We are an equal opportunity employer. That means we don’t discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. We also consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law, including but not limited to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance. title: Head of Cybersecurity
description: About Us KIDAN is a fast-growing, family-owned IT consulting company headquartered in Switzerland, serving nearly 1'000 enterprise clients. Since 2020, we’ve been helping businesses turn IT into a strategic advantage through smart, secure, and scalable solutions. We specialize in IT management and security, and we are the exclusive Swiss distributor of ManageEngine, with strong partnerships including Cloudflare, Colortokens, SentinelOne, Zoho, Horizon3, Quest, and others. Our team of international experts is driven by excellence, integrity, and a people-first mindset. At KIDAN, we don’t just solve IT problems—we enable long-term business success. Be part of a mission where technology drives progress and people lead the way. Job Description Key Responsibilities 1. Own KIDAN's Cybersecurity Posture Own KIDAN's overall cybersecurity posture, strategy, policies, standards and roadmap. Ensure cybersecurity is embedded across KIDAN's technology, operations and internal environment. Identify and challenge cyber risks, gaps and priorities, and drive corrective actions. Own cybersecurity compliance and support certifications and frameworks such as ISO 27001. Work closely with Technology, Operations and leadership to ensure cybersecurity is built into how KIDAN operates. Be technically involved in assessing KIDAN's cybersecurity architecture, technologies, configurations, controls and implementations. Regularly go beyond governance and documentation to validate that cyber controls are actually implemented and working effectively in practice. 2. Provide Hands-On Technical Cybersecurity Leadership Act as a technical cybersecurity leader who can get into the field and work directly with technical teams. Review and challenge cybersecurity architectures, technical designs, configurations, implementations and controls. Participate directly in complex cyber investigations, incident response, escalations and technical problem-solving when required. Work alongside engineers, cybersecurity specialists and SOC analysts to solve complex cyber challenges and improve technical capabilities. Maintain a strong understanding of the technologies, tools and platforms used across KIDAN's cybersecurity environment. Be able to independently understand and assess technical cyber issues rather than relying exclusively on the team for technical interpretation. Set the technical standard for the cybersecurity organization and continuously raise the team's technical maturity. Remain sufficiently hands-on to maintain technical credibility with both internal teams and enterprise customers. 3. Own & Develop the Cybersecurity Offering Own the strategy, quality and relevance of KIDAN's cybersecurity offering. Continuously challenge and improve our cybersecurity services, capabilities and value proposition. Ensure our SOC and cybersecurity services (e.g. detection and response, threat intelligence, vulnerability management, cyber resilience) are technically strong, operationally mature and aligned with enterprise customer needs. Stay close to the actual delivery of our cybersecurity services and understand how our offerings are implemented in real customer environments. Work with the commercial and technology teams to identify opportunities to grow KIDAN's cybersecurity business and revenue. Ensure what we sell is what we can genuinely deliver at a high standard. Participate in the design and evolution of cybersecurity solutions, architectures and service models. Support the team in complex technical customer opportunities where senior cybersecurity expertise is required. 4. Challenge Cybersecurity Delivery Ensure cybersecurity services and projects are delivered to a consistently high standard. Stay close to delivery and regularly engage with the teams doing the technical work. Challenge processes, technical decisions, architecture and delivery quality where cybersecurity standards are not met. Review technical deliverables and cybersecurity implementations where appropriate. Oversee the SOC team and ensure strong operational performance, processes, quality and continuous improvement. Establish clear cybersecurity KPIs, controls and quality standards. Step into critical delivery, technical escalations or cyber incidents when the situation requires senior technical expertise. Ensure lessons from cyber incidents, projects and customer engagements are translated into improvements across the cybersecurity function. 5. Enterprise Customer & Cybersecurity Escalation Point Act as a senior cybersecurity point of contact for key enterprise customers. Be comfortable going into customer environments and engaging directly with technical teams, cybersecurity teams, IT leaders and executives. Lead or support customer discussions around cybersecurity strategy, architecture, compliance, cyber risk and major requirements. Participate in technical workshops, cyber risk assessments, architecture discussions and complex customer engagements. Act as the escalation point for critical cybersecurity topics, incidents and customer concerns. Be able to discuss technical cybersecurity topics at depth with experienced customer cyber and IT professionals. Build trust with customers by bringing strong technical expertise, credibility and business understanding. 6. Cybersecurity Leadership & Governance Establish clear cybersecurity governance, ownership and decision-making across KIDAN. Ensure cyber risks are visible and appropriately escalated to leadership. Partner with Technology, Compliance, Operations and other functions on cybersecurity priorities and risk management. Lead, coach and develop the cybersecurity team, creating a culture of technical excellence, ownership and continuous improvement. Lead by technical credibility and expertise, not only through management and delegation. Stay current on relevant cyber threats, attacker techniques, technologies, regulations and industry standards, and translate them into actionable priorities for KIDAN. What Great Looks Like KIDAN has a strong, credible and continuously improving cybersecurity posture. Cybersecurity is not only documented and compliant. It is genuinely strong in practice over all KIDAN. KIDAN is recognized internally and externally as a credible cybersecurity partner, not simply an IT company that also sells cybersecurity. KIDAN is able to confidently demonstrate its cyber maturity to enterprise customers. Our cybersecurity offering is relevant, technically strong, differentiated and commercially valuable. Our SOC and cybersecurity services are delivered consistently, professionally and to a high standard. All are continuously challenged and improved. KIDAN's cybersecurity revenue grows because customers trust our expertise and see clear value in our offering. Enterprise customers know they have a senior, credible cybersecurity expert they can trust and escalate to. Cyber risks, incidents and compliance gaps are identified early and acted upon. Technology and cybersecurity teams work closely together, with cybersecurity embedded into how KIDAN builds and delivers technology Requirements Strong senior experience in cybersecurity, security operations or a CISO-level role. Strong understanding of cybersecurity strategy, governance, risk, compliance and security operations. Experience managing or leading a SOC / cyber defense function. Strong understanding of enterprise cybersecurity and cybersecurity service delivery. Experience working directly with enterprise customers and senior stakeholders. Strong ability to challenge technical and business decisions and communicate cyber risk clearly. Experience with ISO 27001 and relevant cybersecurity frameworks Fluent in French and English. German is a strong advantage. Strong commercial awareness and ability to connect cybersecurity capabilities to customer value and business growth. Hands-on, credible and comfortable operating across strategy, technology, delivery and customer conversations. Find more English Speaking Jobs in Switzerland on Arbeitnow

Du verstehst klinische, pflegerische oder administrative Abläufe und erkennst, wo digitale Lösungen im Alltag einen Mehrwert schaffen. Du bringst Erfahrung im Produktmanagement, Business Development, Lösungsvertrieb oder in einer vergleichbaren Funktion an der Schnittstelle zwischen Gesundheitswesen, ICT und Markt mit. Du kannst verkaufen: Du erkennst Kundenbedürfnisse, formulierst überzeugende Nutzenargumente und begeisterst unterschiedliche Anspruchsgruppen für eine Lösung. Du trittst sicher auf und präsentierst gerne – im persönlichen Kundengespräch ebenso wie in Workshops oder vor einem grösseren Publikum. Du bist kommunikationsstark, vernetzt Menschen und koordinierst die Zusammenarbeit über Bereichs- und Unternehmensgrenzen hinweg. Du packst an, übernimmst Verantwortung und bringst Themen mit Eigeninitiative, Struktur und Beharrlichkeit zum Abschluss. title: Senior Backend Engineer, Backend Platform (PHP and Python)
description: WHO WE ARE 🌍 Creating content that resonates is great — turning that attention into growth is even better. That's what Manychat does. Our AI-powered automations help creators and brands engage with audiences across Instagram, Messenger, WhatsApp, and TikTok — at the right moment, with the right message, minus the manual work. We're 400+ people across three continents behind the leading platform for conversational growth, with AI skills shaping how we build, how we work, and how we grow. WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR 🌟 Want to own how the backend works for everyone, not just one corner of it? We’re looking for a Senior Backend Engineer who works across PHP and Python and wants a say in the bigger picture. You’ll lead company-level projects like our Auth Service: one authorization layer for PHP and Python, so Python products can handle their traffic directly instead of going through PHP. When things are unclear, you’ll research first, weigh the trade-offs and write them down. Then you’ll ship in small, safe steps. You’ll also decide where code should live based on what’s best for the system, not on which language you know best. Product teams will come to you for advice, reviews, and a way through when they're stuck. The team is still taking shape, so you'll also help define ownership, standards, and how we work. If that mix of deep technical work and influence across teams sounds like you, keep reading. YOUR FUTURE TEAMMATES 👋 Meet the Backend Platform team: We're a small team of engineers from core PHP, Infra, and AI backgrounds. We lead technical initiatives across the whole backend and own its health. Product teams build and run their own components, and we give them the tools, standards, and expertise to do it well. Each of us leads our own project, from planning to agreeing with other teams to production. We work in weekly cycles and write our decisions down. Right now we're bringing PHP and Python platform work together into one common backend platform. WHAT YOU'LL DO 🚀 Lead company-level technical projects end to end, from design and planning to rollout and support, such as completing our Auth Service development and shaping authorization as a separate layer for PHP and Python. Shape the shared PHP and Python platform, and decide where each module should live based on the needs of the whole system. Build the foundations that let new Python products launch and scale without being wired through PHP each time. Define clear ownership of technical components across the backend, including who owns monitoring and knowledge for each. Improve how we spot and handle problems: bug and incident management, less noise in alerts and error tracking, and Grafana Cloud dashboards for how services interact. Find root causes across PHP and Python services using metrics, logs, and distributed tracing. Make performance part of everyday work, not something we fix after incidents: clear performance metrics, tools that show where things slow down, and analysis of unusual user behavior that causes degradation. Make architecture decisions with high load in mind, working with databases, servers, proxies, and DNS alongside the Infra team. Work with the Security team to fix vulnerabilities, build in security practices, and keep libraries and dependencies up to date. Improve developer experience: dev environment, CI/CD, routine automation, one documentation approach for PHP and Python, and tools for AI coding assistants. Turn product teams' requests into solutions: find what really hurts, propose the best fix, and support them with architecture advice and reviews in shared components. TO SHINE IN THIS ROLE 💥 You'll need: Production backend experience in PHP or Python, and the ability to read and work with the other. You'll write production code in both. Experience with high-load production systems and improving their performance. Experience designing multi-component systems with clear boundaries, planning for failures, rollout, and rollback, with security in mind. Experience comparing technical options, naming the trade-offs, and explaining your choice in writing (ADRs, Design Docs). Hands-on observability experience: metrics, dashboards, alerts, logs, and distributed tracing, and using them to find root causes. Experience leading a project that spans several teams: breaking it into small, testable steps, getting other teams on board, and taking it to production. A track record of improving engineering quality beyond your own tasks, for example setting up error monitoring, or a new process when things kept breaking. Enough infrastructure knowledge (databases, servers, proxies, DNS) to work well with Infra and see how your changes affect them. Clear communication: you explain your point of view, find the real problem behind a request, and flag risks early. Experience leading work independently while supporting your team: taking feedback, helping colleagues grow, and changing your mind when the arguments are good. It would be great if you have: Experience on a Platform or Core team. Strong production experience in both PHP and Python. Experience with authentication and authorization systems (for example, JWT or Ory Oathkeeper). Experience defining SLOs and building symptom-based alerts. Experience running incidents and blameless post-mortems. Experience with Grafana Cloud, Rollbar, or similar tools. Experience building developer tooling, CI/CD, or tools for AI coding assistants. Experience mentoring engineers or leading knowledge sharing across teams. WHAT WE OFFER 🤗 We care deeply about your growth, well-being, and comfort: 🌍 Hybrid onboarding to start work remotely and relocation support for you and your family. 💙 Comprehensive health insurance for both you and your family. 📚 Professional development budget for conference tickets, online courses, and other relevant resources to help you grow. 🫶 Flexible benefits package: no one-size-fits-all perks here. You get a budget and you decide where it goes, from health and wellbeing to family and setting up your home office. 🪴 Hybrid work and generous, flexible time off — planned with your team, not rationed by a rigid quota. 🍽️ In-office perks, including free meals and snacks. 🤝 Company-funded sport activities, annual offsites and team-building events. 🤖 AI isn't a perk here — it's how we work. Claude, OpenAI, and more are on by default from day one, and we back teams in adopting whatever makes them faster. Manychat is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We’re committed to building a diverse and inclusive team. We do not discriminate against qualified employees or applicants because of race, color, religion, gender identity, sex, sexual preference, sexual identity, pregnancy, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, marital status, physical disability, mental disability, medical condition, military status, or any other characteristic protected by local law or ordinance. This commitment is also reflected through our candidate experience. If you have individual needs that may require an accommodation during the interview process, please indicate this in your application. We will do our best to provide assistance throughout your interview process to ensure you’re set up for success. We trade options and delta one around the clock on the largest crypto venues. Our platform runs on a Linux bare-metal fleet alongside cloud deployments in the regions where exchanges run, with services written in Python and Rust.

You will make sure everything works, and works properly. Most problems don't stay inside one team's boundaries: a strange fill might come from a network issue, a config change, or an exchange that changed its behavior without telling anyone. You understand what each service does for trading, what it costs when it breaks, and which fix matters most right now. You own an issue from the first alert to the long-term fix that stops it coming back.

You will:

  • Own the live environment. Monitor trading across all our venues, take charge of incidents, and own both the immediate fix and the long-term one.

  • Bridge infrastructure, engineering, and trading. Translate a trader's “something looks off” into a root cause, and a root cause into a priority the right team can act on.

  • Partner with the desk. Work closely with traders and quants, so reliability work is driven by what actually matters for PnL and risk.

  • Debug across the full stack. Linux and network performance, exchange connectivity, messaging and databases (Kafka, NATS, Redis, PostgreSQL/TimescaleDB, ClickHouse), and the Python and Rust trading services themselves.

  • Own our hybrid infrastructure. Run the bare-metal fleet and cloud deployments, plus their configuration management and deployment pipelines across environments.

  • Build observability. Use Prometheus/VictoriaMetrics, Grafana, Sentry, and Kibana to catch a problem before the trading desk does.

  • Change things safely. Plan and run maintenance, upgrades, and releases without trading going dark.

  • Raise the bar. Cut toil with automation, and spread SRE practices across Tech so every team builds reliable systems from the start.

What we're looking for

You'll need:

  • 5+ years running production systems where uptime and correctness matter, in an SRE, DevOps, systems, or software engineering role.

  • At least 2 years of that in a trading environment (a trading firm, exchange, or broker), working directly with live trading systems and traders.

  • A working understanding of how trading systems operate: order and quote flow, positions and PnL, exchange connectivity, and why latency and correctness matter.

  • A commercial mindset. You can weigh technical trade-offs against business impact and explain them clearly to traders and engineers alike.

  • Strong Linux skills, including troubleshooting performance at the OS and kernel level.

  • Solid networking fundamentals: TCP/IP, UDP, and multicast, plus comfort reading a packet capture.

  • Hands-on experience running production workloads in a public cloud (AWS or similar): networking (VPCs, peering, cross-region latency), compute choices, and infrastructure as code (Terraform or similar).

  • Proficiency in Python, and the ability to read and debug code you didn't write, including our Rust services.

  • Hands-on experience with configuration management (Ansible or similar) and CI/CD.

  • Experience operating at least some of our stack: Kafka, NATS, PostgreSQL, ClickHouse, Redis, Prometheus, or Grafana.

  • Calm, structured incident handling, and clear communication in English under pressure.

Bonus points for:

  • Experience with options or crypto markets.

  • Exchange connectivity experience (WebSocket or FIX APIs).

  • Low-latency or market-making environments.

  • Hands-on Rust experience. Much of our platform is written in it.

  • Network hardware (Arista, Cisco), routing protocols, or packet capture tooling.

  • Server hardware and kernel tuning for low latency.

  • Running data-heavy systems such as time-series databases.

Pay, location, and relocation

  • Compensation: a competitive base salary plus a performance bonus based on individual and company results.

  • Trading fund: outstanding performance is rewarded with the opportunity to buy into the trading fund.

  • Location: On-site at our Amsterdam office

  • Visa: BlockTech sponsors the Dutch highly skilled migrant visa.

  • Relocation: All-in relocation package and Dutch classes for international hires. Eligible hires may qualify for the 30% ruling.

What else is in it for you

  • Pension plan, company laptop, and home internet reimbursement

  • An extensive in-house training program and an annual learning and development budget

  • An environment that embraces AI, both to speed up your work and to advance our systems

  • Gym reimbursement and sports during working hours: kickboxing, CrossFit, fitness, and soccer

  • Weekly Friday drinks, monthly outings, quarterly sports competitions, and two trips abroad a year

  • Daily breakfast and warm lunch, plus snacks and drinks all day

Excellent communication skills, with the ability to work cross-functionally and influence stakeholders at all levels. raw.title: Senior Account Executive - Benelux
raw.description:
Help fix customer-centricity at scale


Every company wants to become more customer-centric. At TheyDo, we make that ambition real. Our AI-powered journey management platform helps the world’s largest enterprises align around what matters most: their customers. By bringing scattered data and teams together, we empower smarter decisions and better experiences. Since 2019, global leaders across industries — including Ford, Cisco, Johnson & Johnson, Siemens, Home Depot, and Lufthansa — have trusted us to scale journey management and deliver measurable impact.

Backed by $50M from top-tier investors, including Blossom and 20VC, we are building a category-defining company. Our fully remote team of 100+ TheyDoers represents 30+ nationalities across 27 countries, united by a customer-led, people-first culture.

Our mission is clear: Make journey management the most powerful business tool in the world.

If you’re looking for a place where your work shapes the future of how companies operate, join us. Let’s build it together.

The role

Journey management is becoming a must-have for the world's biggest companies, and TheyDo is the platform leading the category. Enterprises like Ford, Cisco, Vodafone and Pfizer already use TheyDo to understand their customers end to end and decide where to act.

Now we're going after the rest of Europes biggest brands, and we want you leading the charge. As a Senior Account Executive, you'll take a greenfield territory of enterprise accounts, open the doors, and land the new logos that define TheyDo's next chapter.

You'll be based in the Benelux, working remotely and reporting to Stephan. You'll join a team of 6 EU AEs, backed by SDR, Enablement and Customer Success colleagues across North America and Europe.

Why this role, now

The timing couldn't be better. Customer experience has moved into the boardroom, and enterprises want a way to turn it into decisions. TheyDo gives them that, and our customers are proving it.

Europe is wide open. Your target list is full of companies that look just like the ones already buying from us, and most of them have never had a TheyDo conversation. We know what wins. Now we need someone to scale it and put their name on the logos that come next.

This is the moment to join: early enough to shape how we win, with the proof that we do.

What you'll do

This is a role built around creating revenue that didn't exist before, not managing revenue that already does.

Build your own pipeline. You'll start from a target list, not a book.

  • Own a named list of Benelux enterprise accounts and decide where to focus, based on signal rather than hope

  • Source most of your pipeline yourself through outbound, account-based plays with BDR and Marketing, events and executive networking

  • Break into accounts with no existing relationship and find the senior person who owns the customer experience problem


Win the first deal. You'll take a cold account all the way to signature.

  • Run complex, multi-stakeholder cycles from first conversation through discovery, business case, procurement and close

  • Sell on value to C-level and VP buyers across CX, Product and Digital: a business case a CFO will sign, not a feature tour

  • Land mid-to-high six-figure first deals, structured to expand, and hand them to Customer Success with the context to grow them

Shape how we win. You'll help write the European playbook.

  • Refine our ICP, messaging and sales motion based on what you see in the field

  • Share buyer insight with Product so they can act on it

  • Forecast accurately and keep the team informed through clear async updates

What this role isn't

We'd rather be clear now than have the wrong person find out six months in.

  • It isn't account management. You won't inherit renewals or an installed base to upsell. If most of your number has come from growing existing customers, this probably isn't your role.

  • It isn't inbound-led. Marketing and SDR will support you, but you'll be expected to create most of your own pipeline.

  • It isn't a finished machine. If you need fully built enablement, years of territory data and a playbook that tells you what to do next, you'll find this frustrating. If you want to help build those things, you'll find it energizing.

What we're looking for

  • 4+ years closing B2B SaaS deals, with most of that in enterprise new-business roles selling into enterprise organizations.

  • A track record of exceeding annual quotas, where the majority of your closed revenue came from net-new logos you sourced yourself. Be ready to walk us through the numbers.

  • Proven ability to land mid-to-high six-figure first deals with enterprises that weren't customers before.

  • Experience selling a platform or new-category product, where you had to create the need rather than respond to an RFP.

  • A value-selling methodology (MEDDPICC, Command of the Message or similar) you actually use, not just know.

  • Confidence engaging C-level buyers, building consensus across stakeholders and navigating enterprise procurement, security and legal

  • You'd rather start with a blank target list than a handed-over book, and you're energized by a scale-up where the product and playbook move fast

Bonus points if you have experience selling to CX, Product, Digital or Design leaders

What we offer our permanent employees:

💰 Competitive compensation and pre-IPO equity - we like to give our team members ownership with our stock package. When TheyDo succeeds, we all succeed!

🌍 Fully remote working with flexible hours - we're staunch advocates for autonomy and flexibility.

🩺 Health Insurance benefit - at TheyDo our team’s health and wellbeing are a priority. We include tailored support for every employee, regardless of location.

🌴 Flexible holiday days – We love what we do and equally love taking a break. You'll have a minimum of 25 days of paid holiday per year (pro rata), in addition to public holidays and an extra three days during our annual company-wide winter shutdown in December.

🧠 Learning and Development budget we encourage everyone to take ownership and invest in their growth and development, providing financial support to benefit you in your role and career.

🧘‍♂️Wellbeing budget - nurture your mind and body. We’ll support you in looking after you, whether it's meditation, mindfulness, or a yoga/gym membership.

👪 Paid parental leave - we'll ensure financial support and time off for you to bond with the newest little members of your family (6 months for the primary carer, and 6 weeks for the secondary carer - fully paid). We provide paid childcare leave when you need to take time out to help your little one recover.

👨‍💻Home office or co-working support - choose your ideal workspace with our home office or co-working budget. Whether you prefer the comfort of your home office or the collaborative atmosphere of a co-working space, we've got you covered.

🗺️ Company events - we regularly connect in-person to strategise, reflect or simply have fun. Our most recent company retreats were held in Spain, Portugal and France.

⚒️ Latest tech & tools - MacBook Air or Pro, we want you to have the equipment that you’re most comfortable with. We use tools such as Gather, Slack, Notion, Loom, G:Suite and naturally TheyDo to work collaboratively and asynchronously.

🚀 Continuous growth of our benefits package as we continue to grow in size

To any recruitment agencies, we appreciate you would like to support us but we do not accept any unsolicited CVs or introductions.

About TheyDo

Our core values are the driving force behind every decision we make.

We ‘Journey together’ along a path of collaboration and synchronization. In everything we do, we ‘Own it’, never shying away from taking action or making decisions. Our ‘Cloaks off’ mentality ensures that transparency and integrity reign supreme. We ‘Simply to accelerate', cutting through complexity to focus on what truly matters and moving forward with clarity and speed Moreover, ‘Customer Fueled’ innovation is at the heart of our work, as we know that the success of our product is directly linked to how we involve our customers in the process.

TheyDo is an equal opportunities employer. Our customers are diverse, and we believe our organisation should be, too. We nurture an inclusive culture where everyone feels equally important, no matter their background or status. We will never discriminate on the grounds of gender, civil status, family status, sexual orientation, religion, age, disability, education, or race.

Our commitment to building a diverse and inclusive TheyDo includes making reasonable adjustments to the interview process. If you need any adjustments, please reach out to your Talent Partner.

If you are a woman or part of an underrepresented group, we encourage you to apply. Even if you don’t check every box — your skills and perspective could be just what we need to succeed. We value diversity and know you bring something unique to the table!

title: Senior Sales Operations Manager (South EMEA)
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>Our Purpose<strong><br></strong></h3> <p>At SentinelOne, we are driven by a clear purpose: to give the advantage to those who secure our future. As AI reshapes how organizations build, operate, and innovate, the responsibility to protect them becomes more critical than ever. When you join SentinelOne, your work helps protect global enterprises, critical infrastructure, and the technologies shaping tomorrow. If you are motivated by meaningful challenges and want your impact to be real, measurable, and global, you will find purpose here.</p> <h3>About Us<strong><br></strong></h3> <p>SentinelOne is a company at the intersection of AI and security, pioneering a new operating model for cybersecurity. Our AI-native platform unifies protection across endpoint, cloud, identity, data, and AI systems to deliver autonomous detection and response with clarity and speed. By combining real-time analytics, intelligent automation, and a unified data foundation, we reduce noise, simplify complexity, and empower security teams to focus on what truly matters.</p> <p>Our teams are builders, problem-solvers, and innovators committed to shaping the future of security. If you are excited to solve hard problems alongside talented, mission-driven people, we invite you to help us build a safer future for humanity.</p> <h3><strong>What Are We Looking For?</strong></h3> <p>We’re looking for people who are relentlessly curious and committed to continuous learning. AI is reshaping every function across our business, and we enable every team member, regardless of role or level, to build fluency in AI tools and concepts. Those who thrive here actively seek out new solutions, experiment thoughtfully, and apply what they learn to drive better, faster, smarter outcomes.</p></div><p>As a Senior Sales Operations Manager, you will support the EMEA South Go-To-Market team as a trusted advisor to sales leaders, enabling consistent, predictable, and repeatable hyper-growth through sales discipline, streamlined processes, and a strong operating cadence. You will partner with the EMEA South Leadership Team on GTM design, business analysis, and metrics while managing the day-to-day rhythm of the business, with field productivity as your north star. This role is based in Amsterdam, Prague, or Milan, and is ideal for someone who wants to be an active voice driving change rather than a passive spectator.</p> <h3>What Will You Do?</h3> <p>Primary responsibilities include:</p> <ul> <li>Serve as the EMEA South Operations Lead and trusted advisor to key sales leaders, actively participating in the EMEA forecasting process, advising on changing pipeline dynamics, and challenging forecasts to ensure accuracy, predictability, and transparency.</li> <li>Manage Area business metrics including performance, trends, headcount, and investment models, and lead the development of key sales metrics and business review materials, monitoring performance and taking action to optimize business results.</li> <li>Drive the annual sales planning process, including Area, Regional, and District goal assignments, territory management updates, and sales compensation plan changes.</li> <li>Identify gaps in the infrastructure needed to support Sales and develop solutions, with a strong focus on AI, that align to the team’s overall vision, while educating and training teams on key sales processes.</li> <li>Act as an active voice that drives change with Area leadership, and align with the Global Revenue Operations team to represent the needs of the field.</li> </ul> <h3>What Skills and Knowledge Will You Bring?</h3> <p>Ideal candidates will have:</p> <ul> <li>7 to 10 years of experience in Sales, Revenue, or Field Operations supporting sales teams, with a strong emphasis on enabling teams to be hyper-productive, ideally within organizations selling subscription security software.</li> <li>Experience designing and scaling processes that support a hyper-growth business model, including documenting key processes in a publicly traded environment.</li> <li>Proven analytical ability to turn disparate datasets into insightful analytics, including developing messaging, data visualizations, and executive-level presentations.</li> <li>Solid experience with a key tech stack including Salesforce, Clari, Tableau, MS Office, G-Suite, and AI tools.</li> <li>Strong verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to influence sales teams, build collaborative relationships across functions, and translate the complex needs of the field. A Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Management, Technology, or Economics is required, and an MBA is a plus.</li> </ul> <h3>Why SentinelOne?</h3> <p>AI is redefining how the world operates and rewriting the rules of security in real time, and SentinelOne was built for this moment. From day one, we architected an AI-native platform designed to operate at machine speed, not as an add-on to legacy systems but as the foundation itself. If you want to build where innovation and impact move together, this is that place.</p> <p>We invest in our Sentinels with comprehensive, competitive benefits designed to support you and your family:</p> <p><strong>Equity &amp; Rewards</strong></p> <ul> <li>Restricted Stock Units (RSUs)</li> <li>Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP)</li> </ul> <p><strong>Time Off &amp; Wellbeing</strong></p> <ul> <li>Competitive leave benefits</li> <li>Gender-neutral parental leave</li> </ul> <p><strong>Insurance &amp; Financial Security</strong></p> <ul> <li>Insurance and medical allowance</li> <li>Pension scheme</li> <li>Employee Assistance Program (EAP)</li> </ul> <p><strong>Work Perks &amp; Flexibility</strong></p> <ul> <li>Global home office allowance</li> <li>Mobile phone reimbursement</li> <li>Commuter or work-from-home allowance</li> </ul> <p><strong>Wellness &amp; Lifestyle</strong></p> <ul> <li>Wellness benefit</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><p><span style="font-weight: 400;">SentinelOne is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">SentinelOne participates in the E-Verify Program for all U.S. based roles.&nbsp;</span></p> <p data-pm-slice="1 1 []">To learn more about how we use AI in our hiring process, please review our&nbsp;<a href="https://assets.contentstack.io/v3/assets/blt53c99b43892c2378/bltca86b3b84e902400/AI-in-Hiring-SentinelOne.pdf">AI in Hiring Candidate Disclosure</a>.</p></div> Find more English Speaking Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

Je kijkt verder dan afzonderlijke berekeningen, waarbij je project overstijgende risico’s signaleert, de scope afbakent en klanten helpt weloverwogen keuzes te maken. Je werkt voor onder meer netbeheerders, infrabeheerders en eigenaren van kabels en leidingen.

Dit ben jij bij Movares

Je combineert diepgaande technische kennis met overtuigende adviesvaardigheden. Je bent klantgericht, pragmatisch en oplossingsgericht en weet complexe normering begrijpelijk uit te leggen zonder de technische nauwkeurigheid te verliezen. Je neemt verantwoordelijkheid voor je projecten, zoekt actief de samenwerking op en durft richting te geven aan klanten en collega’s.

Dit breng je ook mee:

  • een afgeronde hbo- of wo-opleiding in elektrotechniek, technische natuurkunde of een vergelijkbare technische richting;

  • ruime relevante werkervaring, bij voorkeur circa tien jaar, met EMC, elektromagnetische beïnvloeding, hoogspanningssystemen of een aanverwant specialistisch vakgebied;

  • ervaring met technisch advies, projectmatig werken en het vertalen van normen en onderzoeksresultaten naar concrete maatregelen;

  • ervaring met GIS applicaties en programmeren in MATLAB of Python is een pré;

  • kennis van de NEN3654:2023 en RLN00398 is een pré.

Dit krijg je bij Movares

Bij Movares werk je aan opgaven die Nederland verder helpen. Tegelijk krijg je de ruimte om je werk en loopbaan in te richten op een manier die bij jou past. Met goede arbeidsvoorwaarden, veel flexibiliteit en volop mogelijkheden om je te ontwikkelen.

Een sterk fundament

Een goede basis begint bij voorwaarden waarop je kunt rekenen:

  • een salaris tussen €6.250 en €7.250 bruto per maand op basis van 40 uur;

  • een flexibele pot van minimaal 15% van je jaarsalaris, inclusief vakantiegeld;

  • een goede pensioenregeling bij Zwitserleven, waarbij Movares twee derde van de pensioenpremie betaalt;

  • een NS Business Card voor woon-werkverkeer en zakelijke reizen. Privé profiteer je met de kaart van de dalurenkorting.

Maximaal flexibel

Vorm een manier van werken die aansluit bij jouw leven én jouw ambities. Maak keuzes die bij jou passen:

  • flexibel werken volgens ons Any Time Any Place-principe, passend bij je team, klanten en projecten;

  • de mogelijkheid om twee weken per jaar te werken vanaf je vakantieadres binnen de EU;

  • 20 vakantiedagen bij een fulltime dienstverband, met de mogelijkheid om extra dagen te kopen vanuit je flexibele pot;

  • met je flexibele pot kies je wat voor jou belangrijk is, bijvoorbeeld voor extra inkomen, pensioen, een fiets, bedrijfsfitness, verduurzaming van je woning of het aflossen van je studieschuld;

  • € 750 budget per vijf jaar om je thuiswerkplek goed in te richten;

  • € 2,45 netto thuiswerkvergoeding per thuiswerkdag.

Veel ontwikkelmogelijkheden

Ontwikkel een loopbaan die past bij jouw talenten en ambities. Kies jouw eigen pad:

  • ruimte om je expertise, ambitie en loopbaan verder te ontwikkelen;

  • leren door te doen, samen met ervaren collega's en met gebruik van een breed aanbod aan ontwikkelmogelijkheden;

  • de kans om actief kennis te delen en mee te bouwen aan de toekomst van ons vakgebied.

Samen groeien

Deel mee in de waarde die we samen creëren en de groei van onze organisatie. Samen voor succes:

  • je flexibele pot groeit mee met de resultaten van Movares;

  • een winstdeling met een doelbedrag van 5% van je bruto jaarsalaris, afhankelijk van de resultaten;

  • en de mogelijkheid tot participeren in de waardeontwikkeling van Movares door middel van aankoop van phantom aandelen.

Jouw team bij Movares

De afdeling Energie is een gezellige en sociale club van ongeveer 50 collega’s. Regelmatig organiseren we gezellige teamuitjes, organiseren we uitdagende kennissessies en zijn we aanwezig op leerzame events! Als onderdeel van team Energie sta je midden in de energietransitie. Samen met je collega’s benader je deze enorme uitdaging procesmatig en vanuit de inhoud. Door een zeer professionele way of working kom je met elkaar tot creatieve en toekomstbestendige adviezen én ontwerpen die we aanbieden aan opdrachtgevers als TenneT, Stedin, ProRail, Provincies, Ministeries en Rijkswaterstaat. De afdeling Energie focust zich op duurzame energievoorziening, rail energiesystemen en EMC & netkwaliteit.

Movares is zeer ervaren en groot genoeg om succesvol te zijn in de meest uitdagende projecten van het land. Deze uitdagingen ga jij vanuit afdeling Energie aan binnen een informele organisatie met korte lijnen. Jij en je collega’s zijn zeer betrokken bij het werk. Samen met hen voer jij projecten uit in het werkveld Energie, voor ‘onze’ opdrachtgevers. Daarnaast werk je met teams van andere afdelingen samen aan multidisciplinaire projecten. Zo proef je verschillende werkvelden en leer je van adviseurs en engineers in meerdere disciplines. Jouw ontwikkeling gaat altijd door!

title: Backend Software Developer
description: Backend Software Developer – Maatwerk Software met Impact Wij weten dat wat op het eerste gezicht eenvoudig lijkt, vaak complexer is dan men denkt. Proactief meedenken over en het inrichten van CI/CD pipelines, applicatie-uptime en databeveiliging. Bijdragen aan de codekwaliteit door middel van code reviews en het actief delen van kennis met jouw teamleden. Effectief asynchroon samenwerken, documenteren en code opleveren binnen een distributed, remote-first team. Wie ben jij? We zoeken een developer met een HBO werk- en denkniveau die al de nodige stappen heeft gezet in het bouwen van cloud-native applicaties . Je hebt sterke ervaring met de TypeScript/Node.js stack en modern software-development zoals Agile/Scrum, CI/CD en Infrastructure as Code kent voor jou geen geheimen. Je bent niet alleen een developer, maar je kunt ook écht zelf cloudomgevingen operationeel krijgen en beheren met tools als AWS CDK, Terraform of CloudFormation . Algemene cloud kennis is een vereiste; specifieke ervaring met AWS of Scaleway is een pre . Je geniet van technische puzzels, levert graag goed geteste code op en voelt je thuis in een Node.js backend. Verder ben je woonachtig in Nederland . Wat bieden wij jou? De Organisatie : Snelgroeiende, vooruitstrevende organisatie met sterke visie en focus op maatschappelijk relevante software. Autonomie : Veel ruimte voor eigen initiatief, ondernemerschap en technische autonomie. Maatschappelijke Impact : De kans om bij te dragen aan bekende, maatschappelijk relevante applicaties voor platformen zoals NPO Start, Pathé Thuis en het KNMI binnen een uitstekend beoordeeld top-tier maatwerk softwarebedrijf (Emerce100 koploper). Salaris : Bruto maandsalaris tussen de €4000,- en €6000,- passend bij jouw ervaring. Vakantiedagen : 25 vakantiedagen om lekker uit te rusten. Werkplek & Sfeer : Een fijne remote-first cultuur met volledige flexibiliteit, een gezellige werksfeer en inspirerende maandelijkse co-working dagen. Mobiliteit & Thuiswerken : Kilometervergoeding van €0,25/km of volledige OV-vergoeding, gecombineerd met een maandelijkse thuiswerkvergoeding. Pensioen : Een uitstekend en goed geregeld pensioen. Ontwikkeling & Extra's : Ruime mogelijkheden voor opleidingen en trainingen, plus actieve deelname en toegang tot het eigen event Appdevcon en diverse kennissessies. De 'Gadget Kit' : Een high-end MacBook Pro, een 27 inch 5K display, testdevices en een volledig ingerichte thuiswerkplek. Events & Fun : Toffe teamactiviteiten en gezellige, bedrijfsbrede Summer en Winter Events. Over Dawn Technology We bouwen niet voor de massa, maar voor betekenis. Onze klanten komen uit sectoren die er écht toe doen – van zorg en educatie tot duurzaamheid en publieke dienstverlening. We verstoppen complexiteit achter eenvoud en bouwen software die logisch voelt. En precies dát maakt ons werk elke dag boeiend. Samen met een groep van bijna 250 digitale specialisten delen we kennis, zoeken we de nieuwste technologieën op en versterken we elkaar. Benieuwd om te horen hoe het is om bij Dawn Technology te werken? Luister dan eens naar deze podcast . Solliciteren Spreekt deze rol je aan? Laat je gegevens dan achter via de sollicitatieknop. Ook als je twijfelt of je volledig aansluit nodigen we je uit om te solliciteren. Nog vragen naar aanleiding van deze vacature? Neem dan gerust contact op met Dennis Timmerman (Corporate Recruiter) via 0638675360 . Have a great day. Dawn Technology. We gebruiken voor nieuwe kandidaten een assessment (actueel binnen software ontwikkeling) om het niveau objectief vast te stellen. Hiermee onderbouwen we de totstandkoming van het salaris in het recruitmentproces op basis van feitelijke vaardigheden. Dit geeft ons een eerlijk en meetbaar kader voor iedereen. raw.title: Interim Senior Community Manager
raw.description:
Who we are

We believe travel can create Citizens of the World. When people cross Europe slowly, by train, they come back more curious, more open and better able to understand people unlike themselves.

 

With colleagues from more than 50 countries, our diversity sparks curiosity, insight and a culture of openness, which is essential to understanding our travellers and one another.

 

Three values connect everyone at Interrail: we lead with our purpose, we own our impact, and we choose for growth.

 

We work in a hybrid way, from our office in Utrecht and our homes across the Netherlands.

We’re on the search for...

Someone who has built a community for a brand before, and who can bring ours to life online and offline. Since 1959, Interrail has been more than a rail pass. We’re now building it into a cultural movement, and our community is where that movement becomes real: the deeper you travel through Europe, the more the journey changes you, told by the people who lived it.

In 2027 our community moves into the Interrail app and website. Our product and technical team builds the platform. You make it a community: you shape the community vision, bring the first members in, and create the moments, online and in real life, that make travellers come back and help each other.

The Brand team shapes what Interrail stands for and how it shows up wherever travellers meet us. We own our brand platform and positioning, and our community, bringing The Interrail Effect to life through the people who’ve travelled with us. We work closely with Product, Social & Community, Creative & Content, CRM, and the PR & Partnerships teams to keep every touchpoint consistent and culturally sharp.

This is a nine-month interim contract. The team meets in the office a minimum of twice per week, so you’ll be required to join those days to work alongside your colleagues.

 

What you’ll be doing

You’ll be part of the Brand team, reporting to the Brand Lead who owns the Community Program. You’ll lead the community from launch to a community that’s live, safe, well populated and growing, online and offline.

The community isn’t a loyalty scheme or a fan club. It’s where travellers tell the truth about their journeys, inspire others and help the next person go and experience it. You’ll work closely with Product (Social Connection and Loyalty team), Customer Experience, Legal and Privacy, PR & Partnerships, Social, and our Creator Partnerships and Creative colleagues.

You’ll be:

  • Shaping the community vision, values and member code with the Brand Lead, and laying the foundations for Interrail as a cultural movement, online and offline.

  • Building the community strategy: who we bring in first, which journeys launch first and how the community grows after launch.

  • Bringing our existing members across as founding voices, and working with Content and Marketing to onboard our Pioneers.

  • Launching the first community rituals, and making the community a source of real traveller stories for the brand.

  • Designing and running a first pilot of real-world moments, such as gatherings at stations or partner places, with PR & Partnerships and Social.

  • Building good relationships with the independent Interrail communities on Facebook, Reddit and beyond. We partner with them; we never try to replace them.

  • Keeping the community safe: setting guidelines, the moderation approach with Customer Experience, and working with Legal, Privacy, and Safety so nothing goes live until it’s signed off.

  • Being the members’ voice in our Product team, measuring community health with Analytics and CRM, and creating a playbook so what you build lasts.

What we’re looking for

Here’s what will help you in this role. If you don’t match every point, we’d still love to hear from you.

  • 8+ years building communities for brands, including at least one you grew from launch.

  • Experience running community both online and in real life, such as events, meet-ups or ambassador programs.

  • You have written a community vision or strategy and turned it into a plan that others follow.

  • A track record of building early momentum, so people join and champion the community, not just follow it.

  • Experience setting moderation and safety policies, and comfort working with Legal and Privacy on consent, safeguarding and GDPR.

  • A clear point of view on what makes a community healthy, and the confidence to defend it with product teams.

  • Organised, good at documenting and comfortable working across many teams, so what you build outlasts your contract.

  • A genuine interest in train travel, meeting locals, new experiences and other cultures.

Bonus points for experience with community platforms or social SDKs, multilingual moderation, or a long rail trip through Europe of your own.

  

Curious to apply?

Apply directly through our careers page.

 

  • We’ll ask you to share your CV in English (our business language) and tell us why you’re interested in Interrail and this role. It doesn’t hurt to be creative; we enjoy seeing your personality shine through.

  • For some roles, we may also ask you to complete a short task based on the real job, so you can show us your skills in practice.

 

If we’d like to get to know you better, the next step is a first conversation with Talent Acquisition, followed by interviews with the team. It’s a two-way conversation: a chance for you to explore Interrail, and for us to get to know you.

 

To keep our hiring fair, we use blind screening in the early stages. Your name, photo, date of birth, gender, nationality, contact details and social media links are hidden, so our first decisions are based only on your skills, experience and potential.

 

In the meantime

If you’re curious, why not check us out on LinkedIn and get a sense of our culture and values?

 

Got questions? Our team would be happy to help: just drop us a note at

 

While you’re here, you can plan your own trip and find your Pass at www.interrail.com.

We expect you to lead and enable your team to deliver effectively, setting the right technical direction while leveraging the talent present in your team. While we expect you to be technical, your focus will be on strategy and leadership rather than heavy hands-on coding. AI is changing how we build software, and we are going all in. You will lead a team that uses AI in its daily work, from writing and reviewing code to planning, testing and decision-making. We expect you to be a hands-on practitioner who uses these tools yourself and pushes your team to get the most out of them.

Our Tech Stack

At the Backend we mostly use Go, Postgres, and Redis. At the Frontend we use React, Typescript, and NodeJs. Our infrastructure runs on GCP, and we are heavy users of Kubernetes. Our Architecture is a distributed architecture made of several "Modular Monoliths". We practise DevOps, Continuous Delivery, Domain Driven Design, and Contract Driven Development.

 

Your role

In your daily role, your impact will be defined by key pillars: Delivery, Direction, Talent, and Culture.

  • Delivery: Lead your team to scope and plan projects, identifying bottlenecks and improving processes. You will ensure engineering standards are held high and remove impediments to provide a smooth developer experience. 
  • Direction: Create alignment and a sense of urgency through well-crafted strategies and goals. You will direct your team to relate their work to organizational goals and provide a clear sense of purpose.
  • Talent: Nurture talent with regular feedback and performance reviews, supporting career growth. You will identify skill gaps and execute hiring strategies to acquire top talent.
  • Culture: Lead by example to foster ownership, empowerment, and autonomy. You will promote a growth mindset, value diverse perspectives, and address problems to maintain a healthy team culture.
  • Craft: Equip your team to solve problems with pragmatic, sustainable solutions. You will foster engineering excellence, support knowledge-sharing, and keep the team up to date with the latest technical trends.
  • AI-first engineering: Make AI a core part of how your team works, not an experiment on the side. You will drive adoption of AI-assisted development and review, define what good practice looks like, and measure the effect on delivery speed and quality. You will keep the team's standards high while the way of working changes.

 

Your profile

  • 3 years minimum of experience in the field managing a team, focused on building and maintaining complex domains and distributed architectures.
  • Strong recent experience in managing high-performing, diverse, and inclusive teams.
  • Strong knowledge in Distributed Systems and Domain Driven Design.
  • Ability to set technical direction without getting bogged down in heavy hands-on work.
  • Real, recent experience using AI tools in your own day-to-day work and getting your team to do the same. For us AI is central to how we deliver, so if you see it as a nice-to-have, this role is not the right fit.

 

What's in it for you

  • Unlimited paid holidays, minimum-based not maximum!

description: Ben jij ready voor Change? Bij Change zoeken we een Talent acquisition Lead die recruitment naar een hoger niveau brengt. We zoeken daarom iemand die zelf stevig in de werving staat, maar ook het recruitmentteam verder helpt ontwikkelen. Je werkt nauw samen met teamleads, management, HR en collega-recruiters. Je krijgt veel verantwoordelijkheid, ruimte om mee te denken en de kans om zichtbaar impact te maken op de groei van Change. Waar ben je verantwoordelijk voor? Actieve sourcing en hunting Je zoekt actief naar commercieel talent via LinkedIn, jobboards en netwerken. Je weet latent werkzoekenden te vinden en te enthousiasmeren voor Change. Coaching en ontwikkeling van het recruitmentteam Je begeleidt en coacht recruiters in sourcing, selectie, stakeholdermanagement en kandidaatcommunicatie. Je deelt kennis en helpt het team groeien in kwaliteit en eigenaarschap. Operationele aansturing Je brengt structuur aan, bewaakt de voortgang van vacatures en helpt het team prioriteiten stellen. Businesspartner voor sales en operatie Je werkt nauw samen met teamleads, management en HR en vertaalt personeelsbehoeften naar effectieve recruitmentacties. Candidate experience Je zorgt voor een professioneel en persoonlijk recruitmentproces waarin kandidaten zich gezien voelen. Procesverbetering en data Je optimaliseert recruitmentprocessen en gebruikt data om resultaten en effectiviteit te verbeteren. Talentpools Je bouwt aan talentpools voor commerciële en specialistische functies, zodat we ook op de lange termijn succesvol kunnen blijven werven. Wij vinden het belangrijk dat wij bij elkaar passen. Herken jij jezelf in onze kernwaarden? Eerlijk – Je communiceert open, duidelijk en betrouwbaar.  Beweging – Je pakt aan, denkt vooruit en brengt energie in elk project.  Anders – Je ziet mogelijkheden, durft te vernieuwen en houdt het praktisch.  Expertise – Je werkt gestructureerd, deelt kennis en maakt dingen af.  Wat breng je mee? Je hebt minimaal 5 jaar ervaring binnen recruitment, bij voorkeur in een dynamische, commerciële of snelgroeiende organisatie. Je hebt ervaring met actieve sourcing en weet hoe je latent werkzoekenden benadert en overtuigt. Je vindt het leuk om junior recruiters te coachen, te begeleiden en beter te maken in hun vak. Je hebt ambitie om leiding te geven. Je bent sterk in stakeholdermanagement en schakelt makkelijk met teamleads, management, HR en recruiters. Je brengt structuur, overzicht en rust in een omgeving waar veel tegelijk gebeurt. Je hebt ervaring met interviewtechnieken, ATS-systemen en recruitmentdata. Je weet hoe je commercieel talent herkent en kunt beoordelen op salesdrive, overtuigingskracht, eigenaarschap en resultaatgerichtheid. Je bent zelfstandig, proactief en krijgt energie van targets, groei en resultaat. Je durft mensen aan te spreken op eigenaarschap, opvolging en kwaliteit. Je denkt mee over processen, maar blijft niet hangen in plannen. Jij zorgt dat dingen gebeuren. Je spreekt en schrijft vloeiend in de Nederlandse taal. Ervaring met employer branding of doelgroepgerichte arbeidsmarktcommunicatie is mooi meegenomen. Wat wij jou bieden! Een uitdagende functie binnen een snelgroeiende en dynamische organisatie. Een salaris tussen €4.500 en €5.500 per maand (op fulltime basis). Een aantrekkelijke bonusstructuur op basis van prestaties en resultaten. Een contract voor 32 tot 40 uur per week. Km vergoeding of NS businesscard voor jouw woon- werk verkeer. Veel ruimte voor persoonlijke en professionele ontwikkeling. Een ambitieus en energiek team waarin samenwerking centraal staat. De mogelijkheid om écht impact te maken op de groei van onze commerciële organisatie. Ready for Change? Zie jij het als een uitdaging om zelf sterke commerciële kandidaten aan Change te verbinden én een recruitmentteam verder te ontwikkelen? Dan leren we je graag kennen. title: Stage tijdschriftredactie Libelle
description: Amsterdam  – Wil jij ontdekken hoe een tijdschriftredactie werkt, van eerste idee tot een verhaal in print én online? En lijkt het je leuk om mee te denken én te werken aan rubrieken en artikelen in Libelle? Dan hebben wij misschien wel een plek voor jou op de human interest-redactie. Op de human interest-redactie maken we de journalistieke producties voor Libelle. Denk aan de interviews met BN’ers, persoonlijke verhalen, vaste rubrieken zoals De dag nadat en Hoe het begon, columns en de verhalen over psychologie, gezondheid, maatschappij en werk & geld. Wat ga je doen? Je werkt mee aan vaste rubrieken in Libelle (bijv. In gesprek met Libelle, De Denktank, Hoe het begon) Je neemt zelf interviews af voor rubrieken in print en mogelijk ook online. Je bedenkt onderwerpen die aansluiten bij de doelgroep en pitcht ideeën voor de HI-planning. Je ondersteunt de human interest-redactie (de redactiemanager, coördinator en producer) bij de dagelijkse werkzaamheden. Het gaat om een fulltime stage (32 tot 40 uur) per februari 2027. Wil je op een later moment stagelopen? Reageer vooral, dan kijken we vast naar de mogelijkheden. De stagiair die wij zoeken: Volgt een relevante HBO- of universitaire opleiding (bijvoorbeeld Journalistiek of Creative Business). Beheerst de Nederlandse taal uitstekend en schrijft foutloos. Weet wat er speelt. Is een creatieve schrijver. Kan makkelijk schakelen tussen print en online. Heeft affiniteit met de doelgroep van Libelle. Heeft een proactieve houding. Is vanaf februari voor 5 á 6 maanden beschikbaar en minimaal 3 dagen per week. Wat krijg je van ons? ● Een leuke omgeving, goede begeleiding, borrels en de gezelligste collega’s. ● Een unieke stage om ervaring op te doen. ● Een marktconforme stagevergoeding van €400,- op basis van een fulltime dienstverband. ● En een laptop van de zaak. Stagelopen bij DPG Media Stagelopen bij DPG Media betekent niet alleen dat je de door jou geleerde theorie in de praktijk brengt door een bijdrage te leveren aan onze ambitieuze teams, ook ga je bij ons écht wat leren. Een aanvulling ben je zeker, want jouw creatieve en frisse blik wordt erg gewaardeerd. Na je stage kan je zeggen dat je ook nog eens écht toffe dingen hebt bereikt én hebt gewerkt bij het grootste mediabedrijf van Nederland. Zet dat maar op je cv! Over DPG Media DPG Media heeft met haar sterke merken een stevige marktpositie in alle onderdelen van de mediabranche. Elke dag werken we met ontzettend veel plezier aan ons portfolio dat bestaat uit uiteenlopende A-merken, waaronder AD, AutoWeek, DonaldDuck, Libelle, Margriet, Linda, NU.nl , Qmusic, vtwonen en RTL. Je wordt dus onderdeel van een groter geheel: met al onze merken bereiken we elke maand 98% van de Nederlanders. Hoe tof is dat? Interesse, en dan? Heb je direct zin om aan de slag te gaan? Solliciteer dan nu! Stuur je motivatiebrief en je cv mee met je sollicitatie. Find more English Speaking Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

This is a hands-on role for someone who can execute fast, iterate with creative and funnel inputs, and scale what works. You’ll inherit high-performing campaigns and work directly with our CMO to double down on growth.

You’ll then also have the opportunity to test and scale new channels (TikTok, Meta, Snapchat, Native, ASA) depending on performance and market constraints.

Your Responsibilities

Campaign Ownership and Scaling

  • Take the lead on one or two paid acquisition channels (e.g., Meta, TikTok, Google, etc.), with potential to expand scope based on performance

  • Contribute to building scalable acquisition funnels, from execution to iteration, with aggressive growth targets in mind

  • Run high-velocity testing loops (creatives, audiences, placements) to improve CAC and LTV

Performance Analysis and Strategy

  • Monitor performance daily using tools like Voluum, GA4, and internal dashboards

  • Own the creative briefing process: define hooks, formats, and angles based on performance patterns

  • Collaborate closely with the content and product teams to launch and iterate on high-converting landing pages

Partnership Management & Media Strategy

  • Build strong relationships with traffic sources and negotiate premium placements and custom deals

  • Explore new acquisition opportunities (networks, formats, tools) and build internal evaluation criteria

Automation & Scaling Systems

  • Identify opportunities to streamline acquisition processes through automation and internal tools

  • Create SOPs, playbooks, and experiment pipelines for scaling campaigns efficiently

Challenges You’ll Tackle

  • Scale existing campaigns to 3x+ budget while maintaining CAC/ROAS goals

  • Contribute to growing the user base from 30M to 100M users in the next 12 months

  • Execute 0-to-1 testing in new channels

  • Improve conversion through landing page testing and funnel iteration

  • Own both creative input and analytical feedback loops

Your Qualifications

Hard Skills

Must-Haves

  • 4–10+ years in performance marketing or user acquisition

  • Proven track record managing $300K to $1M+/month in paid media spend

  • Full ownership of campaign execution, results, and optimization

  • Experience with Meta, TikTok, Snapchat, ASA, or native platforms

  • Analytical fluency: GA4, Voluum, tracking setups, dashboards

  • Strong creative instincts: can write briefs, analyze hooks, and iterate fast

  • Experience optimizing landing pages and funnel conversion

Nice‑to‑Haves

  • Past exposure to subscription models and CAC/LTV frameworks

  • Experience in sensitive or regulated verticals (e.g. dating, femtech, telehealth)

Soft Skills

🗣 Strong communication & collaborative skills (perfectly fluent in English)

🎯 Goal-oriented, ownership and commitment

⚡️ Doer mindset - we are moving fast and need people who can balance execution, planning, and strategy

⏱️ Obsessive about speed, performance and iteration

🧢 Humble - willing to learn, open to feedback

🍭 #NSFW - Comfortable advertising products based on uncensored models and content

Why EverAI?

📈 Exponential Growth: From 60M users in 3 years, to 100M next — and 500M beyond

🚀 Track Record of Category-Creating Innovation: We consistently launch world-first AI applications — setting the pace, not following it

🌍 Global Impact: Top-tier user growth, real-world adoption, and cultural relevance

🧠 Proven Leadership: A senior team that’s launched, scaled, and exited & IPO’d multiple scale ups — now fully focused on reshaping AI companionship

👥 Elite Remote Team: 100% remote and built to win — world-class talent from Tier 1 tech companies, with a culture of ownership, velocity, and radical creativity

🛡️ Ethical Core: Our AI ecosystem is governed by EverGuard, our proprietary AI moderation technology, ensuring responsible development at scale

What We Offer

📍 Work From Anywhere: Fully remote. Choose the environment where you do your best work

👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Annual Gathering: A yearly in-person meetup to connect, brainstorm, and celebrate wins together

Challenge cost and effort and make the make-or-buy call per subsystem.</li> <li>Work closely with the System Software Architect on the hardware/software split, real-time control, and safety architecture.</li> <li>Drive the hardware contribution to risk management (ISO 14971), including design FMEA and risk control measures.</li> <li>Plan and lead hardware verification, pre-compliance and and an employee stock option plan.</li> <li>A lean, senior team with short decision paths.</li> </ul> <h3 data-section-id="1pw1999" data-start="3755" data-end="3777"><strong data-start="3758" title: Platform Engineer
description: Platform Engineer – Maatwerk Software met Impact Wij weten dat wat op het eerste gezicht eenvoudig lijkt, vaak complexer is dan men denkt. We ontwikkelen hoogwaardige maatwerk software die het leven van mensen verrijkt. Achter elke krachtige applicatie staat een stabiele en schaalbare cloudinfrastructuur. We maken geen compromissen op kwaliteit en zoeken altijd naar de best mogelijke oplossing, tot in de kleinste details. Om onze groeiambities te realiseren zoeken we een Platform Engineer . Iemand die zelfstandig complete IT-omgevingen ontwerpt, bouwt en automatiseert. Je pakt complexe migraties van A tot Z op en bouwt met visie aan een ijzersterk platform. Jouw rol Als Platform Engineer ben je verantwoordelijk voor het volledige proces van requirements tot oplevering. Je ontwerpt, bouwt en automatiseert moderne IT-infrastructuur voor uitdagende klantprojecten. Met tools zoals Terraform en Ansible til je onze automatisering naar het hoogste niveau. Je begeleidt complexe klantmigraties van A tot Z met oog voor detail. Daarnaast borg je een uitstekende overdracht en heldere documentatie voor je collega's. Zo creëer je voorspelbare, veilige en toekomstbestendige omgevingen voor maatschappelijk relevante organisaties. Wat je zal gaan doen: Ontwerpen en opbouwen van schaalbare IT-infrastructuur op basis van klantvereisten. Automatiseren van omgevingen en processen met Terraform, Ansible en scripting. Zelfstandig uitvoeren en begeleiden van complexe klantmigraties. Inrichten van krachtige cloud- en Linux-omgevingen op platformen zoals Scaleway, AWS en Azure, volgens de nieuwste standaarden. Opstellen van heldere documentatie en verzorgen van een vlekkeloze kennisoverdracht. Waarborgen van de veiligheid, capaciteit en performance van het platform. Adviseren van klanten en collega's over slimme infrastructurele keuzes.   Na succesvolle oplevering draag je de omgeving over aan onze Hosting Engineers, die het dagelijkse beheer overnemen. Jij richt je vervolgens op het volgende project. Wie ben jij? We zoeken een ervaren professional met hbo werk- en denkniveau . Je voelt je thuis in Linux en Infrastructure as Code . Tools zoals Terraform en Ansible hebben voor jou geen geheimen: je bent echt een bouwer die zich als een vis in het water voelt bij deze technologieën. Je hebt ruime ervaring met het zelfstandig ontwerpen en migreren van complete IT-omgevingen. Je communiceert helder, pakt eigenaarschap en werkt gestructureerd. Verder woon je in Nederland en spreek je bij voorkeur Nederlands . Wat bieden wij jou? De Organisatie: Je versterkt een snelgroeiende, vooruitstrevende organisatie met een sterke visie en focus op maatschappelijk relevante software. Autonomie: Je krijgt veel ruimte voor eigen initiatief, ondernemerschap en technische autonomie. Maatschappelijke Impact: Je werkt aan uitdagende projecten met een directe en tastbare maatschappelijke impact. Salaris: Een bruto maandsalaris tussen de €4.500,- en €7.500,- passend bij jouw ervaring. Vakantiedagen: 25 vakantiedagen om goed uit te rusten en op te laden. Werkplek & Sfeer: Een gezellige werksfeer op ons kantoor in Hilversum met flexibele werktijden, hybride werken en elke dag een verzorgde lunch op kantoor. Mobiliteit & Fiets: Een kilometervergoeding van € 0,25/km of een volledige OV-vergoeding, én een fiscaal aantrekkelijk fietsplan. Pensioen: Een uitstekend en goed geregeld pensioen voor jouw toekomst. Ontwikkeling & Extra's: Ruime mogelijkheden voor het volgen van opleidingen en trainingen om te blijven groeien, plus een jaarlijks Coolblue thuiswerkbudget van € 500,- om je werkplek perfect in te richten. Events & Fun: Toffe (lokale) teamactiviteiten en gezellige, bedrijfsbrede Summer en Winter Events. Over Dawn Technology We bouwen niet voor de massa, maar voor betekenis. Onze klanten komen uit sectoren die er toe doen. Denk aan de zorg, educatie, duurzaamheid en publieke dienstverlening. We verstoppen complexiteit achter eenvoud. We bouwen software die logisch voelt. Precies dat maakt ons werk elke dag boeiend. Samen met een groep van bijna 250 digitale specialisten delen we kennis. We zoeken de nieuwste technologieën op en versterken elkaar. Neem dan gerust contact op met Dennis Timmerman (Corporate Recruiter) via 0638675360 . Have a great day. Dawn Technology.
